A few years ago, Dan A, a government employee at the Ministry of Finance, was forced to take on the burden of raising children, housework, and making a living alone due to her husband’s declaration to enter Yeouido. In her dispatched location in St. Lucia, she experiences an absurd incident where she is cut off from the outside world due to an electricity supply problem. After many twists and turns, she successfully returns home… but as soon as she steps foot on the airport, what catches her eye is the news of her husband’s election?! Dan A’s divorce request is not accepted, and to make matters worse, when her personal information is leaked nationwide, she decides to choose divorce after her term rather than the red letter of the president’s divorcee, and begins a contract marriage. Since then, Dan Ah surprises the nation by showing unique behaviors that maintain her career. Meanwhile, a complicated and subtle atmosphere flows with her husband, who she has finally reunited with after a long time… Will the secret of the first working First Lady and the president be kept until the end?

(Source: Korean = tcokr.com || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the novel "My Husband Got Elected" (남편이 당선됐다) by Ha Eun Kwang (하은광).
779486.title: My Husband Got Elected

779492.synopsis:
The admissions office of Q University, whose mission to increase the competition rate for college entrance exams is a burning flame, is scouting Ro Hui, a famous admissions officer from A University, but the shocking words that come out of her mouth at the entrance information session are, “Everyone with a grade below 3, please leave.” Ro Hui, a new type of admissions officer who shouts, “Inflated hopes are a failure in college entrance exams,” is gaining fame as the 'Fact Violence Admissions Officer' and shaking up YouTube’s In-Gyeop-Dong and the admissions office. 

Meanwhile, Yu Seok, a Korean language teacher at a high school, is busy encouraging his students as a homeroom teacher for third-year students, but he is surprised twice: once by Ro Hui’s shocking words and once by the fact that she was a former classmate. The values ​​of Ro Hui, a cool-headed admissions officer, and Yu Seok, a passionate homeroom teacher for third-year students, clash sharply, but why do they keep running into each other at the entrance exam fair and university tour…! 

The two people who repeatedly meet by chance on the front lines of college entrance exams come to learn the truth behind their relationship.

(Source: Korean = tcokr.com || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the novel "This Is the Q University Admissions Office" (여기는 Q대학교 입학처입니다) by Kwon Je Hun (권제훈).
779492.title: This Is the Q University Admissions Office

aka: เพลงรักวัยละมุน
779546.synopsis:
Sa Gye, the charismatic vocalist and guitarist of top K-pop group 'The Crown', is unexpectedly forced to enroll at Hanju University—a campus he’s never even set foot on—after a sudden accident. Thrown into an unfamiliar world, he chaotically navigates his way through college life and fatefully meets Kim Bom, a gifted vocalist and keyboardist from the band 'Tusagye', who once dreamed of the Ivy League but turned to music after her mother’s passing six years ago. As they grow closer, Sa Gye’s passion for music reignites and he forms a mysterious band to start music again. Meanwhile, Seo Tae Yang—a brilliant guitarist and med student that comes from a family of doctors—adds tension as he competes with Sa Gye, both musically and personally. Caught between love, rivalry, and harmony, the trio ignites a new chapter in their musical journey.

(Source: MyDramaList)
779546.title: Spring of Youth

779564.synopsis:
Lee Ji An is a single mother who has lived firmly with her confidence as her weapon. When she faces difficult situations, she always deals with the problem with her simple character and persistence. There's no such thing as a free lunch to her. Lee Ji An works as a construction site manager, who controls everything that goes on there. Her daughter is Lee Hyo Ri, and she is a medical school student. Lee Hyo Ri is the pride of Lee Ji An's life, and she means everything to her. Things change for Lee Ji An when her daughter begins to rebel, and Lee Ji An's first love enters her life again.

Her first love is Ryu Jeong Seok. He is a single father and lives peacefully with his son Ryu Bo Hyeon. Ryu Jeong Seok's peaceful life changes due to Lee Ji An and her daughter Lee Hyo Ri, as they suddenly barge into his life. His son Ryu Bo Hyeon is a young man who has known from an early age what he wanted to do, and he has run a flower farm for 6 years. He is a veteran in the flower farming field, but he begins to have new emotions due to Lee Hyo Ri. She parks in front of Ryu Bo Hyeon's house with a camping car.

(Source: AsianWiki)
779564.title: Love, Take Two

779596.synopsis:
The disciplined stuntman Jae Yeon teaches action to the idol actor Do Ha. Do Ha tries to win Jae Yeon, which he doesn't like, though they learn from each other. Jae Yeon attracts popularity after appearing in an idol show. Jae Yeon helps Do Ha after an injury and the two grow closer, though he refuses his confession due to the agency's pressure...

(Source: Vigloo)
779596.title: Match Play

aka: No Way Out One Night Stand
779598.synopsis:
A hilarious romance between neighbors and cousins ​​that depicts the story of an old bachelor and an old maid who have an outdated notion that men and women must get married after sleeping together and accidentally spending a night together after meeting each other, who are the complete opposites of their ideal types.

Lee Mu Gae is a capable bachelor who is a literary critic and editor-in-chief of a publishing company. He is a dutiful son, a top student, and takes great care of his younger sister, but because of his timid personality, he is not good at confessing his love, and his specialty is unrequited love. Do Do Hye is a spinster who is the head of a publishing company's design department. She, who is a master at playing alone, is a woman who believes that she is the perfect bride in terms of face, body, and ability. However, she also has a strange ability to block men who approach her.

(Source: Korean = JoyNews24.com || Translation = MyDramaList)
779598.title: Useless Love

779732.synopsis: ~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Moving” (무빙) by Kang Full (강풀).
779732.title: Moving Season 2

779790.synopsis:
Ji Yeon, whose life was ruined by false rumors, sets out to get revenge on her used-to-be best friend, Yu Mi.

(Source: Shortime)
779790.title: Dear X

779918.synopsis:
With Dae Yeong and Jeong Ha now in a relationship, they enjoy their private time as a loving couple. Ready to start cohabitating, an old camcorder is found, allowing them to reminisce their high school memories.

(Source: MyDramaList)

~~ Only episode 1 has an uncut version.
779918.title: Seoul Blues: Spin-off

779994.synopsis:
U Hyeon has feelings for his homeroom teacher and intends to keep this hidden until graduation. However, when his best friend, Do Ha, finds out, U Hyeon fears Do Ha will judge him for liking men.

Surprisingly, Do Ha responds with an unexpected proposal—to date each other until graduation—and so, U Hyeon, wanting to give up his feelings for the teacher, agrees to Do Ha's suggestion.

(Source: Korean = bomtoon.com || Translation = NAY at MyDramaList)
779994.title: Heart Stain

aka: Esquire: Lawyers Dreaming of Becoming Lawyers
780258.synopsis:
Yun Seok Hun is a partner lawyer and leader of the litigation team at Yullim Law Firm. He is a cool-headed risk-taker who pressures his opponents with creative logic. He is admired by his colleagues for his solid skills as a lawyer, but he is not easy to approach because of his cold attitude and complete lack of small talk. Kang Hyo Min is a rookie lawyer and works with Yun Seok Hun. She is socially awkward, but she is righteous and confident. She clashes with Yun Seok Hun over everything, but grows into a real lawyer.

(Source: AsianWiki)
780258.title: Beyond the Bar

aka: Gang Girl Goes to Boy's School
780302.synopsis:
Yeon U, the successor of the Sipgang Clan, the largest gang violence group in Korea, sneaks into a high school after dressing up as a man to remove the successor of the rival gang, according to her father's orders. But... she definitely believed that she could kill him until she fell in love with him!

(Source: HanCinema)
780302.title: Gang Girl Goes to Boys High School

aka: Seoul Jagae Daegieop Danineun Kim Bujang Iyagi
Who Works at a Large Corporation in Seoul
Who Works for a Large Company in Seoul
native: 서울 자가에 대기업 다니는 김 부장 이야기
780692.synopsis:
Following the story of a middle-aged man who loses everything he once valued. After a long journey, he finds his true self, no longer defined by his job as a manager at a major corporation.

Kim Nak Su, a salesman with 25 years of experience. Known for his exceptional skills and sales success, he has never missed a promotion. He owns a prime apartment in Seoul, has a wife and son, and enjoys an enviable life. However, over time, he begins to lose his footing both at work and at home.

A heartfelt journey of resilience and survival — one that evokes both tears and laughter in the pursuit of happiness.

(Source: Soompi; edited by MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the novel "Seoul Jagae Daegieop Danineun Kim Bujang Iyagi" (서울 자가에 대기업 다니는 김 부장 이야기) by Song Hui Gu (송희구).
780692.title: The Dream Life of Mr. Kim

78103.synopsis:
Da Eun works part-time, and Kim Byul is an idol. These two girls who look alike decide to change each other's lives just for 7 days. And now, 1 year later, they decided to change one more time because of one event! A special one week is about to start anew.

(Source: Kpopmap)
78103.title: One Fine Week Season 2

781094.synopsis:
In a desperate attempt to revitalize his stagnant career, prosecutor Bang Tae Seop hatches an absurd, but daring plan: take down the mayor of Seoul by exposing her corrupt ties to Lee Yang Mi, the head of the WR Group conglomerate. Tae Seop recruits Hwang Jeong Won to serve as an informant and manages to convince Kwon Jong Uk, a WR Group heir with his own grudge against Yang Mi, to join his cause.

However, Tae Seop soon finds himself in a more complicated situation than he initially expected when he discovers that his wife Chu Sang A, a formerly-loved actress, may be hiding dangerous secrets from him.

(Source: Viki)
781094.title: Climax

781118.synopsis:
The campus couple Min U and Ji Na always have Park Wan around, and Ji Na starts noticing something strange. "Does Park Wan like Min U?" Her suspicions are all too correct, and even Min U can't hide his sentiment. Ji Na pushes Park Wan away, but despite her warning Park Wan kisses Min U in front of her, to which Min U doesn't refuse. In shock, Ji Na is left to ask what happened between the two.

(Source: Vigloo)
781118.title: My Man's Man

781124.synopsis:
Kim Hui Ju works as a security screening agent at an international airport. Due to her boyfriend Lee Do Gyeong, who works as a co-pilot for an airline, she accidentally receives gold from a smuggling organization. Kim Hui Ju becomes obsessed with the gold. She becomes the center of chaos, greed, and betrayal involving various people, including loan shark employee Jang Uk, detective Kim Jin Man, and executive Park Ho Cheol from the gang Geumsung, engaged with the hotel casino Gold Land.

(Source: AsianWiki)
781124.title: Gold Land

781126.synopsis:
A romance story between Yun Je, a timid part-timer who is afraid of guns and swords and kills people in outrageous ways, and Jin Hyeok, a former superstar baseball player who has been saving Yun Je's targets for some time.

(Source: Korean = NamuWiki || Translation = MyDramaList)
781126.title: The Killer Next Door

aka: Because There Is No Next Life
781436.synopsis:
A story of three female friends who are 41 years old.

Cho Na Jeong used to be a TV home shopping host and earned hundreds of millions of won for her work. Now, she is a full-time housewife and mother to two sons. She tries to make a comeback as a home shopping host and earn the high salary she once made.

Koo Ju Yeong works as a planning manager at an art center which displays high-quality performances. She seems to have a perfect life in both her personal and business life. In fact, she endures pain while trying to have a baby with her asexual husband.

Lee Il Ri is single and works as a deputy editor-in-chief for a fashion magazine. She started her career as a fashion editor and has worked her way up to deputy editor-in-chief. She still holds a fantasy about marriage, a dream that she hasn't yet achieved.

(Source: AsianWiki)
781436.title: Don't Call Me Ma'am

781538.synopsis:
Set in an alternate version of Korea ruled by a constitutional monarchy in the 21st century. The story follows Chaebol heiress Seong Hui Ju, who is frustrated by her 'commoner' status despite having everything, and melancholic Grand Prince Yi An, whose royal blood is his only identity and who has nothing despite being the son of the king.

Seong Hui Ju, the second daughter of Korea’s wealthiest conglomerate, is blessed with striking beauty, brains, and a fierce competitive streak, yet she is limited by her status as a 'commoner'. She then chooses to enter a contract marriage with Grand Prince Yi An to gain the one thing she lacks — royal status. Meeting Yi An, a man who shares a similar predicament to hers but has made different life choices, marks a turning point in her life.

Grand Prince is a title granted to another son of the king born to the queen consort in the Joseon Dynasty, signifying his royal lineage while placing him outside the direct line of succession to the throne. Prince Yi An, despite his royal blood, is unable to truly own anything and leads a life of sorrow. As the second son of the royal family, he has been forced to suppress his passionate desires and live in silence, but he is still regarded as the "most beloved royal" by the people due to his innate dignity and charm. Accustomed to hiding his true self, his life begins to change as he meets Seong Hui Ju, who resembles him in some ways but has made different choices, through their contract marriage.

(Source: Times Now; edited by MyDramaList)
781538.title: Perfect Crown

781778.synopsis:
Every girl Jae Hyeon liked has always liked Sun U. Feeling inferior, Jae Hyeon explodes in front of Sun U, to which he suggests if 'he wants a taste'. So starts a love battle between the two men, where the loser is the one to confess first.
Jae Hyeon is slowly attracted to Sun U's deep flirting, will he be able to win the love battle?

(Source: Vigloo)
781778.title: You Want Some?

781808.synopsis:
One phone call was enough to shatter one's entire world. For unknown actress So Min, everything collapses when a voice phishing scam tears her family apart. She is thrust into the darkest side of technology as her missing mother, father's death, and even the stolen voice of her late mother become weapons in a shocking scheme. With nothing left but the will to take revenge, she turns to deepfake technology as her ultimate weapon, infiltrating a vast and merciless syndicate. Along the way, she encounters Ma Seok Gu, a ruthless boss hungry for power, Jeong Hun, a cop torn between truth and loyalty, and Do Jin, a hacker with a sinister smile. Plunging into a web of betrayal and danger with the fake identities she forges, will she exact vengeance, or will they destroy her?

(Source: Kocowa)
781808.title: No Mercy

781958.synopsis:
Do Hoe, a high school student living with his father who runs a taekwondo gym in the countryside, hates the violent and barbaric atmosphere of his family. One day, Ju Yeong , a bright and cheerful friend of the same age who dreams of going to college to major in taekwondo, comes to visit from Seoul, and even Do Hoe’s dark life is filled with big and small joys. However, the negative influence of the oppressive culture symbolized by his father inevitably distorts their relationship, and they are separated by an unexpected incident and reunite after 10 years.

(Source: Korean = bifan.kr || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Release date: Jul 7, 2024 (Festival)
781958.title: Let Free the Curse of Taekwondo

782114.synopsis:
Je Mun Jae is a writer who lives in seclusion. His quiet, routine life is upended when his phone’s fingerprint recognition fails and the friend who managed his affairs disappears. With no way to prove his identity, he discovers that the “Rat” has stolen his name, identity and fortune. Determined to reclaim his life, Mun Jae begins tracking the elusive figure.

No Ja is a loan shark who also runs a private investigation agency and will do anything for money. After searching for Mun Jae for three years because of an unpaid loan, No Ja is drawn into the case when Mun Jae reappears and asks for help to uncover the “Rat’s” identity. To take back his life, Mun Jae teams up with No Ja and together they set off in pursuit.

(Source: Soompi; edited by MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Field Mouse" (들쥐) by Ludvico (루드비코).
782114.title: Mousetrap

782440.synopsis:
Danny, a content creator running an independent online channel, receives an unexpected proposal from Ho Yeon, a long-time fan.

(Source: 날으는펭귄 flyingpenguin YouTube)
782440.title: Only for Fans

782616.synopsis:
Han Mu Cheol, nicknamed "K-Scrooge", is a ruthless miser and wealthy landlord who values money over everything, even his family. His greed begins to backfire when misfortune strikes. His high school rival and current tenant, Kim Dae Sik, a devoted father running a chicken shop with his wife, faces bankruptcy after Mu Cheol raises the deposit. Their mutual friend Choi Gyu Tae, a smooth-talking real estate agent managing Mu Cheol’s buildings, struggles to secure funds for his son's urgent heart surgery, revealing the cracks in their relationships and values.

(Source: MyDramaList)
782616.title: Good Luck!

782622.synopsis:
Kim U Ju is the only son and fourth-generation heir of Myungsoondang, South Korea’s oldest bakery, founded 80 years ago. He is a talented marketing team leader and perfectionist, yet a logical narcissist determined to run the family business in his late father’s place. His professional relationship with Yoo Me Ri, a designer from a partner company, takes an unexpected turn, pulling them into a whirlwind situation that forces him to become her fake husband.

Yoo Me Ri is a quirky and hot-tempered designer who seeks out a fake husband to protect the newlyweds' special prize of a top-class townhouse. She is a bride-to-be who, having experienced a series of hardships in her life, including a broken engagement due to her fiancé's infidelity and a fraudulent lease of her new home, proposes to Kim U Ju, who has the same name as her ex-fiancé, in order to protect the newlywed home she won after the breakup.

(Source: Soompi; edited by MyDramaList)
782622.title: Would You Marry Me?

782624.synopsis:
Actress Im Se Ra is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award in 1999. That same night, she is hit by a truck and suddenly wakes up 25 years later in the body of Bong Cheong Ja, a middle-aged woman. Determined to return to acting and discover what happened to her, she is joined by Dokgo Cheol, a former violent crimes detective who was demoted to traffic duty. As they work together, Cheong Ja and Cheol uncover a mysterious past connection that could change both of their lives.

(Source: ENA, Viki; edited by MyDramaList)
782624.title: My Troublesome Star

782626.synopsis:
This moving, slice-of-life human comedy follows five young adults navigating the bittersweet realities of adulthood, unfulfilled ambitions, and the courage it takes to start over.

For ten long years, Kang Tae Gu, Kim Nam Il and Han Jun Seo have dedicated their entire youth to their unknown comedy trio, "Asura." Despite pushing boundary-testing physical gags and endless passion, they remain completely obscure. Now approaching a critical turning point in their lives, the trio is forced to face the crushing weight of real-world responsibilities and make a heartbreaking choice: hold onto a dying dream, or find the courage to disband.

Their aimless path takes an unexpected turn when they cross paths with sisters Go Eun Young and Go Ji Yeong. Eun Young, a deeply reserved woman whose own life collapsed after a major career failure, finds herself oddly comforted and captivated by the chaotic, unyielding spirit of the comedy group. Together, this unlikely group of five begins to share their vulnerabilities, forming a tight-knit circle of healing.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = ElfinieKarl at MyDramaList)
782626.title: Happy Anding

782680.synopsis:
Ju Yeon subs in on a R-rated dating reality show. Intimate contact is mandatory and bed mate swaps every night! Ex-boyfriend In Ho, nice Jae Hui, and sexy Se Heon is waiting for her in the share house. And their exes start moving in... Participants approach her through a moral-bending rule. Romance vs Money, Instinct vs Reason. Ju Yeon's shaky decision-making begins.

(Source: TVDb)

~~ Adapted from the dating game “Haeyaman Haneun Sweeohauseu" (해야만 하는 쉐어하우스).
782680.title: The Bedmate Game: Sharehouse

aka: The Queen Who Crowns: Dano's Destiny
782696.synopsis:
Depicts the beautiful love and dreams of Won Gyeong and Yi Bang Won who recognized each other at first sight. It is a fateful romance of the first meeting between them, who shared the same dream before embracing the world. Won Gyeong and Bang Won in the late Goryeo Dynasty were lovers who freely shared their love, free from the rules and gaze of the palace before the conflict between the two took hold, the time they shared was filled with love.

(Source: Korean = JoyNews24 || Translation = MyDramaList)
782696.title: The Queen Who Crowns: Before Sunrise

782788.synopsis:
Lee Seol writes an R-rated novel for a competition using her first love, Cha Si U, as inspiration for her male lead. Top-notch producer Cha Si Hyeok is hired to help her make her novel a best-seller, but when he appears, he looks exactly like Cha Si U! He doesn't seem to remember her, and he is nothing like her kind first love from the past, but Seol hides her identity anyway, too embarrassed to face him after basing her male protagonist on him.

(Source: MyDramaList)
782788.title: My R-Rated First Love

782894.synopsis:
Jung Ha, Dae Young, and Min Ji, have been close friends since childhood. One day, the three of them were drinking together, and Dae Young confessed to Jung Ha that he liked him. However, Jung Ha was caught off guard and rejected Dae Young's feelings. Afterward, Dae Young showed up saying that he was dating Min Ji. Jung Ha was surprised by Dae Young's unexpected behaviour, but he tried his best to maintain their friendship.

(Source: TVMaze)
782894.title: Seoul Blues: Uncut Version

782906.synopsis:
The brutal story of the Kim family, who started a counterfeit money business again to pay for non-covered medicine, unexpectedly becoming entangled with criminal organisations.

(Source: Korean = Namu.Wiki || Translation = MyDramaList)
782906.title: My Happy Home

783100.synopsis:
Jung Ji An is the new CEO of the shopping mall Murthehelp. She teams up with her uncle, Jung Jin Man, who has returned, and launches a counterattack against Babylon.

(Source: AsianWiki)

~~ Adapted from the novel "Sarinjaui Syopingmol" (살인자의 쇼핑몰) by Kang Ji Young (강지영).
783100.title: A Shop for Killers Season 2

783280.synopsis:
Despite the setback of not debuting with his original group and the emotional baggage he carries, Kang Min continues to practice relentlessly. He faces pressure to succeed, with reminders of his peers already debuting and achieving their dreams. 

One such day of practicing lends him a long overdue reunion with an ex-boyfriend of his - Su Ho, who used to train alongside Kang Min but is now a debuted idol, looking to practice in the dance room with his other two group members. Storming past the idols, Kang Min leaves the dance room, with Su Ho tailing behind hoping to make amends. Su Ho's attempts at reconciliation are met with anger and resentment, "Who can forget being betrayed by the person they trusted the most? How could that memory go away?" 

(Source: MyDramaList)
783280.title: Two Some Boys

783330.synopsis:
A love story between two university students, So Min Jae and Chae Su In, who are assigned to work on the same group project.

(Source: r/GirlsLove Reddit; edited by MyDramaList)
783330.title: INTP Flirting

783590.synopsis:
'Se Jong's secret weapon, Shadow Unit informer.' Gwi Young, called the Ghost's Shadow, has been wandering around the battlefield since childhood. Vowing to get revenge, he decided to become a member of the nation's best special forces as an informer.

(Source: MangaUpdates)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Chetamja" (체탐자) written by Byeong Jang (병장) and illustrated by Hae Seong (해성)
783590.title: Chetamja

aka: Detective Cheo Yong Who Sees Ghosts
7837.synopsis:
Yun Cheo Yong has been able to see ghosts since birth. Once the ace of the violent crimes unit, seven years ago, he lost both his family and his partner in a traumatic incident that caused him to quit his department. Now, he works as a district cop, but without any interest or will to engage with the world; “starved for love,” he’s completely lonely. 

Then, one day, he accidentally talks back to the ghost of a high school girl, and things get complicated. The show follows Cheo Yong as he works with his female detective partner and that ghost girl to solve mysterious cases.

(Source: MyDramaList)
7837.title: Cheo Yong

783736.synopsis:
Despite coming from a lower-income family and attending a non-prestigious university, Lee Han Yeong longed to rise in the judicial ranks. When he married the daughter of Haenal Law Firm's CEO, he also began a working relationship with her father, using his position as a judge for the firm's benefit. However, as the years went by, Han Yeong's guilty conscience grew stronger, and he eventually defied his orders, sentencing a corrupt chairman to 10 years in prison, only for Han Yeong himself to end up killed.

Miraculously, he wakes up to find himself ten years in the past with all his memories intact, and realizes that he has been given a second chance to make things right. With the help of prosecutor Kim Jin A, Han Yeong strives to deliver justice, even in the toughest of times.

(Source: Viki; edited by MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Judge Lee Han Yeong" (판사 이한영) written by Lee Hae Nal (이해날).
783736.title: The Judge Returns

783738.synopsis:
In the game of life, we all face countless quests of choice. Kang Seong Jae, who enlisted to escape a harsh reality, one day encounters a mysterious virtual "Quest” screen to become an army cook.  With each quest he clears, hidden secrets of the base, even those tied to his father's death, begin to surface.  

After losing his father, Kang Seong Jae enlists in the army to escape reality and soon gains a reputation as a “problem soldier.” But one day, a mysterious Army Cook Quest screen appears before his eyes. Accepting its challenges, he awakens the Eyes of the Chef and becomes the base’s ace cook. As he completes each quest, Seong Jae uncovers a dark web of military corruption.

A senior sergeant at Ganglim Base, Yun Dong Hyeon is an army cook infamous for his terrible cooking and zero sense of taste. Counting down the days to discharge, his peaceful days are disrupted by Seong Jae’s arrival. Annoyed yet unable to ignore him, Dong Hyeon finds himself reluctantly helping Seong Jae clear his quests.

(Source: CJ ENM)

~~ Adapted from the web novel “Becoming a Cooking Soldier Legend" (취사병 전설이 되다) by Jay Robin (제이로빈).
~~ Release dates: Mar 24, 2026 (Episode 1-2 premiere | Festival) || May 11, 2026 (TV)
783738.title: The Legend of Kitchen Soldier

aka: How to Become a Building Owner in Korea
How to Become a Property Owner in South Korea
783740.synopsis:
In Korea, nothing defines success more than owning a building. Ki Su Jong, once an ordinary office worker, believes that going all in—risking everything and drowning in debt—to finally become a landlord will be his way out. But when global capital swoops in and threatens to push his building into foreclosure, Su Jong clings to a desperate plan with his best friend: a staged kidnapping in the building’s basement that spirals into a real one. Trapped in a chain of crimes that could destroy his life or save it, Su Jong is forced to make impossible choices. How far will he go to keep his dream from collapsing?

(Source: CJ ENM)
783740.title: Mad Concrete Dreams

784338.synopsis:
Me Li is a conglomerate's daughter who runs away to the East Sea to avoid a political marriage; she disguises herself as a man and starts a new job at a surfing shop. She becomes entangled with Ha Il, who is afraid of waves due to past trauma. 

(Source: Korean = Namu.Wiki || Translation = MyDramaList)
784338.title: Love Wave

784348.synopsis:
Mr. Shin may look like an ordinary chicken shop owner, but he's the kind of person who appears just in time-when tempers flare, fists are about to fly, and chaos looms-to cool things down with one sharp, satisfying line that settles everything. When Philip, a by-the-book rookie judge, is suddenly reassigned to the chicken shop instead of a courtroom, and Si On, a delivery rider secretly working as Mr. Shin's informant, joins the team, the unlikely trio begins to chase the truth and seek new ground for justice.

Everything seems to be running smoothly-but one question remains: Who exactly is Mr. Shin?

(Source: CJ ENM)
784348.title: Shin's Project

784416.synopsis:
Couple influencers, Eun Seong and Ji Yeon, have only dated for 3 months, but thanks to the algorithm, their popularity skyrocketed.

Now broken up, they’ve been pretending to be a couple for 6 months! Just when everything seemed stable, Gang U enters the picture, leaving Eun Seong torn between his influencer life and true love.

(Source: Shortime Instagram)
784416.title: Influencer Lover

aka: The Records of the Silla-Tang War
784472.synopsis:
Set during the volatile late 7th century, this historical epic chronicles the fierce warfare that erupted as Goguryeo, Silla, Baekje and the Tang Dynasty collided for ultimate supremacy. At the center of the conflict is Kim Beop Min, the visionary prince destined to become King Munmu and complete the monumental undertaking of unifying the fractured peninsula.

Supported by the foundational diplomacy of his father, Kim Chun Chu (later King Taejong Muyeol), and the military genius of General Kim Yu Sin, Beop Min must navigate deadly geopolitical betrayals to lead his people through a grueling war of survival. The series culminates in Silla's miraculous triumph and a historic final showdown against the mighty Tang Empire.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = AnastasiaWun at MyDramaList)
784472.title: Sword & Silence

784484.synopsis:
As a high schooler, Ju I Jae dreamed of becoming a filmmaker, pushing aside other obligations to create her own short films. Her classmate Woo Su Bin, on the other hand, was studious but passionless, resigned to following his family's wishes. Su Bin found inspiration in I Jae’s tenacity, and the two developed a friendship that later turned romantic. However, shortly after their college entrance exams, Su Bin withdrew from I Jae’s life, telling her that his family was sending him overseas.

In their thirties, they live drastically different lives: I Jae is a struggling TV reporter disillusioned with life, while Su Bin is an award-winning film director. Upon their sudden reunion, Su Bin resolves to help I Jae get her spark back, while I Jae still holds a grudge from years before. Can they use this second chance to reconcile?

(Source: Viki)
784484.title: Dream to You

784486.synopsis:
Hyeok Jun, drowning in debt, accepts a “sweet gig” from the mysterious Spider Staffing Agency, offering pay that starts at 50 times the minimum hourly wage, and there’s just one rule: never reveal what happens on the job. But each assignment plunges him into a new hellish workplace filled with bizarre and terrifying phenomena.

As investigator Yeon Ju digs into the agency’s secrets and Hyeok Jun’s spirited sister Ji Yun tries to uncover what’s happening to her brother, they find themselves drawn into the mysterious world of the enigmatic Mr. S. Is the perfect job really a dream, or a nightmare?

(Source: Cora at MyDramaList)

~~ Release dates: Oct 7, 2026 (Episode 1-4 premiere | Festival) || Oct 30, 2026 (Online)
784486.title: Dead-End Job

784546.synopsis:
The story is about a soccer team that is not doing well, and one day, it is bought by an agency. The reason for the acquisition is just to commoditize the team to make money again. The agency takes over and cuts out all the players with a poor face, then forces the actors with a face value from their agency to become players.

(Source: iQiyi)
784546.title: FC Soldout

784558.synopsis:
A child born to become a shaman with the fate of putting the world in chaos. To let go of his greed and refuse god, he’s trying to become an ordinary office worker.

Choi Yeong Hun is the one who can see destiny through physiognomy and fortune telling. Will he succeed in becoming an ordinary office worker?

Im Yeon Hui is a new recruit in Hyunjin Trading’s Sales Team 2. Born with a fate surrounded by enemies on all sides, she is a chic and ambitious woman who charges forward with fierce determination against the destiny given to her.

(Source: MangaUpdates; edited by MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel “Office Worker Who Sees Fate" (운명을 보는 회사원) by Yeong Wan (영완).
784558.title: Office Worker Who Sees Fate

784826.synopsis:
Baek Seol Hui is a single mother with a bright and positive personality, raising her daughter alone. Baek Seol Hui runs a small restaurant. She has an ordinary, but happy daily life with her daughter. Her life suddenly changes due to an unexpected case, in which her daughter is the victim, but is turned into the perpetrator. Baek Seol Hui vows revenge on those who are responsible for that.

(Source: AsianWiki)
784826.title: The Woman Who Swallowed the Sun

785026.synopsis:
The policeman's wife is missing. One year and three months later, his wife returned. The wife died with the child of the killer, the kidnapper, and the child was born. The culprit was not arrested. 20 years later, a boy who has the killer's blood in his veins but was raised by his adoptive father, who is a police officer. A father who tries to protect his son from his son's biological father. A killer who has been tracking down his son in order to continue the evil chain. It is a story about the choices and fates of three men.

(Source: WelCon.kocca.kr)
785026.title: Attributes

785260.synopsis:
A casual purchase of a Checkered Shirt through Karrot Market leads to an unexpected connection with a mysterious man, sparking curiosity and unspoken emotions. Jeong U experiences lingering feelings and encounters new possibilities. 

(Source: Eva at MyDramaList)
785260.title: Checkered Shirt

785270.synopsis:
Kang David, blinded by ambition and materialism, is a former judge turned dedicated public interest lawyer. Kang David is a legal influencer with a flawless work ethic and a clean-cut image, boasting hundreds of thousands of followers on social media. Just as he is about to embark on a brilliant path to success, he gets caught up in an unexpected incident, steps down from his judgeship, and begins a new chapter as a public interest lawyer in a sunless hallway.

Park Gi Ppeum, is a public interest lawyer, who is the complete opposite of Kang David, once she becomes interested in something, dives in deeply—her passion for various hobbies eventually leading her to become a “law enthusiast.” She finds comfort in fulfilling her mission as a lawyer: defending human rights, realizing social justice, and helping good citizens who rely on the beauty of the law.

Kang David and Park Ki Bbeum meet as lawyers on the public interest team of the non-profit organization “Pro Bono.” Using the money earned from defending conglomerates, they provide legal aid to victims with nowhere else to turn, striving to realize true justice.

(Source: Soompi)
785270.title: Pro Bono

785338.synopsis:
In a world where hunters — human warriors who possess supernatural abilities — must battle deadly monsters to protect mankind from certain annihilation, a notoriously weak hunter named Seong Jin U finds himself in a seemingly endless struggle for survival.

One day, after narrowly surviving an overwhelmingly powerful double dungeon that nearly wipes out his entire party, a mysterious program called the System chooses him as its sole player and, in turn, gives him the unique ability to level up in strength. This is something no other hunter is able to do, as a hunter's abilities are set once they awaken. Jin U then sets out on a journey as he fights against all kinds of enemies, both man and monster, to discover the secrets of the dungeons and the true source of his powers. 

(Source: Wikipedia)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Solo Leveling" (나 혼자만 레벨업) by Chu Gong (추공).
785338.title: Solo Leveling

785436.synopsis:
Having lived his entire life as a piano prodigy, Dong Uk finds himself envying Seong Hun’s superior talent - but at the same time, he falls in love with him. 

(Source: Shortime app)
785436.title: Accent

785652.synopsis:
From the first sight, Hyeon Jin and Tae Hyeong mistake each other for the worst, never expecting to meet again, let alone become in-laws. After a tragic accident leaves their nephew U Ju (meaning 'Universe' in Korean) orphaned, Hyeon Jin and Tae Hyeong are left with no choice but to care for him together. Thrown into unfamiliar roles as co-parents, these two different, imperfect adults struggle to navigate not only childcare but also life and love-while slowly beginning to orbit each other.

Seon Tae Hyeong is a photographer who finds comfort in the things he can control-his space, his taste, his rules. But as his brother passed away, leaving behind his child, U Ju, Tae Hyeong ends up raising him with his sister-in-law. Just as their co-parenting starts to settle, he begins to fall for her... unexpectedly and irreversibly.

Woo Hyeon Jin spent her whole life working hard for her sister, the one who always had her back. Then, in an instant, her sister was gone, leaving her with only one way to repay the love: raising U Ju. Forced to co-parent with the unreliable Tae Hyeong, he starts to look different. Still, despite such feelings, there are too many reasons she can't let her heart speak just yet!

(Source: CJ ENM)
785652.title: Our Universe

785888.synopsis:
A sweet romance between the president and the staff.

(Source: Lovememory 러브메모리 YouTube)
785888.title: All for You

785890.synopsis:
A story of Han Min and Jae Beom, whose deep love is shaken when Han Min begins to suspect Jae Beom's infidelity.

(Source: Heavenly)
785890.title: With Me

78607.synopsis:
Depicts the romantic meeting of four men and women in a thrilling airplane, an airport, and an unfamiliar city.

(Source: Naver)
78607.title: Some Air

786472.synopsis:
U Gang, a gaming rookie, decides to follow his friends and visit a gay club for the first time. But in the club, his friends tease him by saying:

"People actually do it in the bathroom here."

Thinking it’s all a joke, U Gang stumbles upon the unexpected. As he processes what he's heard, someone approaches him...

(Source: flyingpenguin_fp Instagram, edited by MyDramaList)
786472.title: Dopamine

786716.synopsis:
Set in the late 1990s, Hong Geum Bo is in her 30s and is an elite supervisor for the Financial Supervisory Service. She is a cool-headed, working woman who only thinks about her job. She goes undercover as a 20-year-old high school graduate, Hong Jang Mi, and begins to work for a securities company where suspicious flows of funds are detected. There, she meets Sin Jeong U. He is the new CEO of Hanmin Securities company. 

Sin Jeong U is a natural-born management consultant and a corporate raider who believes that only numbers are honest. He uses any means necessary to reach his goal. He meets Hong Jang Mi, whose face is the same as Hong Geum Bo's, whom he once loved. They become complicatedly entangled.

(Source: AsianWiki)
786716.title: Undercover Miss Hong

786728.synopsis:
Ambitious prosecutor Ko Eun Sae loses all her memories after a mysterious accident while investigating a powerful crime syndicate. She wakes up in a rural village with no recollection of her name, job, or past, only to be greeted by Jang Tae Ha, a former boxer turned boxing coach who insists he is her boyfriend.

What Eun Sae doesn't know is that Tae Ha is hiding the truth. Once involved with a gang and desperate to leave his past behind, he reunites with his first love when she loses her memory. Determined to protect her from looming danger, he tells a life-changing lie.

As they navigate an unexpected cohabitation filled with secrets, laughter, and growing affection, Eun Sae and Tae Ha must uncover the truth behind her past and discover whether a love built on deception can become the real thing.

(Source: cora at MyDramaList)
786728.title: Our Sticky Love

786734.synopsis:
Based on the highly confidential private family wars of Korean Chaebols, Buy King offers an exclusive glimpse into the engrossing details of the intricate family dynamics and succession wars of Korea’s wealthiest families and each member’s battle to sit at the throne of the multi-billion-dollar family business. This series will especially dive deep into how the generational differences of culture and values can affect not only the succession of power but also a family, company, and even society itself.

(Source: WelCon.kocca.kr)
786734.title: Buy King

786738.synopsis:
Criminal profiler Kang Tae Ju is pulled out of retirement by a chilling summons: an imprisoned serial killer has been linked to additional unsolved deaths through DNA evidence, but he insists that Tae Ju join the investigation, believing that Tae Ju can prove his innocence. Tae Ju is brought back into a world he thought he’d left behind 33 years earlier, forcing him to face ambitious prosecutor Cha Si Yeong, with whom he shares a difficult past, in pursuit of the truth. But as with many cold cases, the truth isn’t as straightforward as it seems – and Tae Ju might be more involved than even he knows. Can Tae Ju finally close the chapter on the "Scarecrow" murders for good, or will a new twist upend his life?

(Source: Viki)
786738.title: The Scarecrow

787024.synopsis:
A man driven by ambition for wealth and power, and the prosecutor who risks everything to stop him. Their fates collide amid the sweeping upheavals of a turbulent era.

(Source: Korean = NamuWiki || Translation = MyDramaList)
787024.title: Made in Korea Season 2

787026.synopsis:
In Tokyo, a gruesome murder is discovered, its victim's body grotesquely contorted and displayed like a work of art. At the scene, Detective Inose encounters Kim Seok, a South Korean detective dispatched to Japan for a joint investigation. As similarly disturbing murders and cryptic messages emerge across South Korea and Japan, the two detectives reluctantly team up to uncover the truth behind the chilling pattern.

(Source: Cora at MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the comic “Blue Road" (푸른길) by Keisi Edogawa and Kwon Ga Ya (에도가와 케이시, 권가야).
~~ Release dates: Oct 7, 2026 (Episode 1-3 premiere | Festival) || Nov 20, 2026 (Online)
787026.title: The Blue Road

787066.synopsis:
Ji Su's ex-boyfriend, Hui Jun, and child actor, Ju Yeon, are double-cast as Romeo, entangling Juliet Ji Su in a love triangle.

(Source: Shortime)
787066.title: Romeo and Romeo and Juliet

aka: Efficient Dating of Single Men and Women
Efficient Encounter of Single Men and Women
787190.synopsis:
Lee Ui Yeong is a successful woman who longs for love but struggles to find it in her everyday life. Turning to blind dates in hopes of romance, she unexpectedly finds herself torn between two very different men. Song Tae Seop, her first date, is gentle and dependable, openly certain about love and marriage from the start. His quiet devotion challenges Ui Yeong to confront her fears about commitment.

Her second date, Sin Ji Su, enters her life under a false identity but wins her over with his sincerity and bold, carefree charm. Younger and impulsive, Ji Su disrupts Ui Yeong’s carefully set rules about love, awakening emotions she never expected.
Caught between stability and passion, Ui Yeong must discover what love truly means — and decide whether she is ready to turn longing into something real and lasting.

(Source: CJ ENM; edited by MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Efficient Dating of Single Men and Women" (미혼남녀의 효율적 만남) by Tari (타리).
787190.title: The Practical Guide to Love

aka: Doctor X: Age of the White Mafia
787220.synopsis:
Gye Su Jeong is a genius surgeon. Introduced through Jang Hui Suk's doctor placement agency, Gye Su Jeong is placed at Guseo University Hospital to fill a surgical vacancy. She proves her worth through her surgical skills, and she exposes absurdities in the medical field. She becomes involved with Bu Seung Gwon, the director of Guseo University Hospital, and intern Park Tae Gyeong.

(Source: AsianWiki)
787220.title: Doctor X: Mafia in White

787476.synopsis:
Only open in the middle of the night to provide top-class service and console the souls of the dead, the Grand Galaxy Hotel has a new moody owner, Eun Ha, with a mysterious past, who arrives after the previous owner’s sudden disappearance.

Upon his arrival, he meets the only human employee Ko Sang Sun, who works hard as the hotel manager with a knack for befriending ghosts. Also, Baek Gi, a free-spirited grim reaper who cleans up the remnants of evil spirits, and Seok San, a mysterious woman with an eerie and dangerous aura.

(Source: Netflix)
787476.title: Grand Galaxy Hotel

787494.synopsis:
Yun Ha Na is a top actress adored across Asia, living a glamorous life at the height of her career. But after a mysterious accident causes her soul to switch with that of her twin brother, Yun Ha Ru, she suddenly finds herself thrown back into the past. Faced with a second chance to change fate, Ha Na becomes determined to save her first love, Jung U Jae — a former judo prodigy turned bodyguard who once lost his life protecting her.

As Ha Na struggles to navigate the past in the midst of unexpected chaos, Ha Ru must cope with waking up in his sister’s body, leading to a series of unpredictable and emotional moments. Alongside them is Son Ye Rang, Ha Na’s powerful agency CEO and Ha Ru’s devoted lover, whose strong exterior hides a deeply vulnerable side.

Four young people whose intertwined destinies challenge love, sacrifice, and the possibility of rewriting the past.

(Source: MyDramaList)

~~ Co-production with U.S. and Japan.
787494.title: Dive into You

aka: The Boy in the Last Row
787500.synopsis:
The story follows Heo Mun O, a failed writer and Korean literature professor who discovers the extraordinary talent of Lee Gang, a quiet boy sitting in the back row of his classroom. Intrigued by the student’s raw brilliance, Mun O offers him private writing lessons, hoping to shape his genius, but as he becomes increasingly consumed by Lee Gang’s stories, the line between mentorship and obsession begins to collapse, dragging them both into a spiral of manipulation, ambition, and chaos.

(Source: Cora at MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the Spanish play "The Boy in the Last Row" (맨 끝줄 소년) by Juan Mayorga.
787500.title: Notes from the Last Row

787524.synopsis:
Music drama series that focuses on six different love stories about the innocence of teen love. Every love story is unique and powerful, packed with scenes that will give you butterflies. Feel the nervousness and the excitement as these young boys and girls fall into each other.

(Source: welcon.kocca.kr)
787524.title: First Love

787526.synopsis:
Seven lifelong friends reunite and discover they all had a crush on the same girl, who confessed?

(Source: Amazon Prime)
787526.title: En-Drama

787550.synopsis:
Pitcher Tae Hun and catcher Jeong Ho, from a struggling high school baseball team on the brink of disbandment, lead their team in their own ways. As they get to know each other's true feelings, they gradually achieve perfect teamwork.

(Source: Shortime)
787550.title: Double Play

787710.synopsis:
“If I tell you I like you, will you believe me?” 

This is an anthology series with four love stories from eight men. Each story has its own unique outcome. 

(Source: GND Studio YouTube; edited by MyDramaList)
787710.title: Close to You

787814.synopsis:
A virtuous star lawyer and devoted fan defends her favorite idol after he is accused of murder.

Maeng Se Na, a prominent lawyer determined to prove that her favorite idol, Do Ra lk, is innocent. She is nicknamed the "lawyer for villains" for taking on unpopular criminal cases that face public criticism; she is secretly a devoted 10-year fan of the band Gold Boys. When her idol becomes embroiled in a bizarre murder case, she conceals her admiration, takes his defense, and uncovers an unexpected truth.

Do Ra lk, the visual center and vocalist of Gold Boys who becomes a murder suspect. When the stage he once longed for no longer brought happiness, and the love of fans felt like a heavy burden, he hid his darkness behind a bright smile. After a murder case turns his life upside down, he throws away his mask and is reborn as someone who lives as if there is no tomorrow.

(Source: Soompi)
787814.title: Idol I

787818.synopsis:
Maeng Gong is the coach of the professional basketball team 'Big Pandas', which has been on the verge of elimination from the playoffs for three consecutive years. Due to poor performance, he is in danger of being fired. When he was young, he was a star player who attacked boldly on the court, as his name suggests, but now he is more famous as the ‘Young Gong Dae' coaching a professional basketball team.

Ko Hwa Jin, a dedicated hater of Maeng Gong, works under the nickname 'Maeng Gong Extermination Group'. He is a high school student who knows how to analyze the game in seconds. He is a character who has become a malicious commenter, full of hostility and a desire to get revenge on Maeng Gong.

With his job on the line, Maeng Gong decides to work with his malicious commenter to achieve team results.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
787818.title: A Head Coach’s Turnover

787936.synopsis:
Cha Su Yeon has stood by her husband, Hyun Min Cheol, throughout his presidential campaign, successfully seeing him elected to office despite previous setbacks. Su Yeon herself was a member of the National Assembly, but her political aspirations were constantly blocked by her father, the party leader at the time, so she shifted her goals to helping Min Cheol. 

In the midst of preparing for her role as the first lady, Min Cheol blindsides her by demanding a divorce just 67 days before the presidential inauguration. The relationship between Su Yeon and Min Cheol grows cold and adversarial, made worse by Sin Hae Rin, Min Cheol's secretive secretary and closest confidant. 

As Su Yeon endures the final two months before inauguration day, she must navigate political conspiracies, family secrets, and power struggles that threaten to upend her life.

(Source: Viki)
787936.title: First Lady

787944.synopsis:
The sports academy romance between Seon U who can’t wait to leave the judo club, and Tae Hyeong who must keep him from leaving.

(Source: Shortime)
787944.title: Summer Indigo

788412.synopsis:
A romance comedy centered on a love-hate relationship between Sin Seo Ri, a legendary villainess from Joseon, and Cha Se Gye, a ruthless modern-day chaebol.

Sin Seo Ri, a nameless actress who becomes possessed by the spirit of a notorious Joseon-era femme fatale, gains a vicious personality. Once a royal concubine of the highest rank who was called a national seductress and sentenced to death by poison, her soul is transported to the 21st century, where she begins a new life.

(Source: kdramacasting X)
788412.title: My Royal Nemesis

788434.synopsis:
Yun Ra Yeong, Kang Sin Jae and Hwang Hyeon Jin have been friends for about 20 years. They first met in their 20's, when they were university students, and they now work together as lawyers at L&J Law Firm. The law firm specializes in defending female crime victims.

Yun Ra Yeong is a star lawyer at that law firm. She is well known on TV, with her outstanding speaking ability and her beautiful appearance. She is a celebrity lawyer with hundreds of thousands of followers on social media. Yet, there are wounds and anxiety that she has kept hidden for years. At an unexpected moment, she faces the shadow of her past that has plagued her.

Kang Sin Jae is an ace lawyer at the law firm. She is the leader among the three friends. She has a lion-like charisma that overwhelms anyone and she gets what she wants through negotiation and intimidation. A crime against a woman, which she usually handles, is entangled with her own past and she faces a crisis.

Hwang Hyeon Jin is a lawyer with an elegant charisma and a fiery personality. She prefers to act rather than sit at a desk. She resists without hesitation anything that she thinks is wrong and goes against her principles, but as her detective husband begins to dig into her past, she begins to shake.

A secret from 20 years ago, which Yun Ra Yeong, Kang Sin Jae and Hwang Hyeon Jin could not speak to anyone about, rises again and shakes the lives of these women. The women grit their teeth and fight back, showing solidarity and tenacity that cannot be broken.

(Source: AsianWiki)

~~ Remake of the Swedish TV series “Honour" [2019].
788434.title: Honour

788470.synopsis:
At Seorin High School, a group of five friends discovers a mysterious app called Girigo that promises to grant any wish—but comes with a deadly curse: anyone who uses it faces sudden, unavoidable death.

As the friends struggle to understand the app’s dark secrets, they must confront fear, suspicion, and the high cost of desire. Every wish carries a price, and escaping the curse may demand more than they ever imagined.

(Source: MyDramaList)
788470.title: If Wishes Could Kill

788474.synopsis:
A romantic comedy drama filled with laughter and emotion, Sleeping Doctor follows Hong Gyeong, a promising psychiatrist who cannot cure her own illness, and Nam Ji O, a pay doctor known as the “Hwa-ta” of the hospital world for his exceptional memory.

After experiencing sexual violence, Hong Gyeong believes she has overcome her trauma and opens the private clinic she has long dreamed of. However, she is unable to treat patients due to narcolepsy, which causes her to fall asleep whenever she stands before them. As she struggles to keep her clinic running, she meets Nam Ji O, a “munchkin” doctor who has mastered medical knowledge across all departments.

Together, they fight to survive the neighborhood clinic scene as self-employed doctors, healing each other and gradually stepping out of the trauma that resurfaces along the way, while growing into love.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
788474.title: Sleeping Doctor

788532.synopsis:
Follows Cha U Seok who investigates an insurance fraud scheme linked to a series of mysterious deaths—only to become entangled with Han Seol A who is suspected to be at the center of it all. The more he digs into her secrets, the deeper he falls into a dangerous attraction that could ultimately cost him his life. With a tantalizing pairing between the two promising an irresistible mix of romance, suspense, and psychological tension, the series asks one question that becomes impossible to ignore: Is she a killer, or is she being framed? And more importantly, will he survive long enough to find out?

Han Seol A is a stunning and provocative head art auctioneer and team leader at Royal Auction, the nation’s leading art auction house. Seol A appears flawlessly perfect on the outside; however, beneath her elegant exterior lies a chilling secret: every man who has loved her has died.

Cha U Seok is the ace investigator of the Insurance Fraud Investigation Unit (SIU). Known for his razor-sharp instincts and exceptional insight, U Seok has held the industry’s top arrest record for life-insurance fraud for years. Dedicated to bringing down those who turn human lives into profit, his unshakable rationality is suddenly thrown into chaos when he receives a crucial tip that leads him directly to Han Seol A.

(Source: Amazon MGM Studios; edited by MyDramaList)
788532.title: Siren’s Kiss

788602.synopsis:
Two women meet to make a second-hand sales transaction. Later, one discovers that the item seems to be broken and contacts the seller, leading to the start of a love story.

(Source: r/GirlsLove Reddit; edited by MyDramaList)
788602.title: Bunny Bunny

788704.synopsis:
A delightful investigative action drama about a bounty hunter, Park Chang, who was a former police officer, and his three brothers, Park Cheol and Park Sal, who take down criminals in one fell swoop. Park Chang, who used to be a detective in the violent crimes unit but now makes a living off of bounties, Park Cheol, a police officer who wanted to be a teacher, and Park Sal, a detective in the criminal information unit who sometimes turns a blind eye to injustice for the sake of his career. The three brothers, who have different ideals and goals, come together with one belief that 'we cannot just turn a blind eye to criminals who have committed crimes' and punish criminals.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
788704.title: The Badge Brothers: Bounty Hunter

788706.synopsis:
Set during the era of the Fifth Republic in the 1980s, the story follows a National Intelligence Service agent who has sworn absolute loyalty to the state and goes undercover as the head of a broadcasting station’s dance team in order to carry out a mission to uncover spies.

Baek Seo Gyeong is an elite agent with a cold-headed and tenacious personality, who places the organization and her mission above all else. While controlling the team members and carrying out the operation, she undergoes unexpected changes and leads the narrative from the center of the story.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
788706.title: Embers

788724.synopsis:
Choi Gang, who is an insurance investigator, was a member of the JDD special operations unit. He possesses an impressive physique, sharp insight, and an exceptional capacity for empathy.

Kwak Byeong Nam, who is the owner of a hardware and stationery store, is a former member of the HID counterterrorism unit who was transferred to the maintenance battalion after suffering a knee injury during training. He has been the youth association president of Sangri-dong for 13 years and is in charge of recycling collection in the neighborhood.

Their neighbors include supermarket owner Jung Nam Yeon, martial arts training gym director Lee Yong Hee, and Seoul University engineering student Park Jung-Hwan.

These people, who have no interest in protecting their country, much less promoting global peace, come together for their families and their neighborhood in this thrilling and humorous story of a reserve special forces unit that unites not to protect the country or promote world peace, but to safeguard their families and neighborhood.

(Source: K-Drama Casting X; AsianWiki)
788724.title: Heroes Next Door

788726.synopsis:
A healing romantic comedy that follows two individuals who pour their hearts into their work every day, yet feel like they have big holes in their hearts.

Matthew Lee, CEO and lead researcher of a natural cosmetics ingredient company, runs the world’s only farm that produces miracle ingredients.

Dam Ye Jin is an ace home shopping host known for her streak of sell-out successes. She handles a wide range of products with expertise, but her intense dedication to work has led her to suffer from chronic, severe insomnia.

(Source: MyDramaList)
788726.title: Sold Out on You

788846.synopsis:
Yu Ha, a job seeker who must do whatever it takes to stand on his own without help from his family, and Min U, a developer desperate to escape the pressure to marry. An unexpected "fake dating contract" ties them together. Though it starts as just a deal, real feelings slowly begin to grow between them.

(Source: Strongberry YouTube)
788846.title: Sweetheart Service

788890.synopsis:
Ba U and Hun have been friends since they were kids – but Ba U has harbored unrequited feelings for Hun for years. Eventually, Ba U tries to cut off his entire relationship with Hun, much to Hun's confusion, who tries to act as if nothing has changed. In a last-ditch attempt to get over his feelings, Ba U takes his friend's advice and asks Hun to date for a single week, which Hun accepts.

However, as Ba U attempts to sort out his complicated emotions, Hun becomes concerned that Ba U is being stalked by Ha Min, and resolves to use their temporary relationship to chase Ha Min away. Will Ba U manage to put his years long crush to bed by the end of the week, or might he and Hun get together for real?

(Source: Viki)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Who Can Define Popularity?" (인기는 무언가 잘못되었다?) by Tak Bon (拓本).
788890.title: Something's Not Right

788910.synopsis:
Jay, an international student from Thailand, comes to Korea to see his friend Seong Hun. The two enrolled in the same college "Health and Happiness" class, and need to submit a physical body assessment for their final project. While Seong Hun already works out regularly, Jay isn't in the greatest shape, and he struggles in the gym. Enter Jin Uk, a personal trainer who takes a special interest in Jay, much to Seong Hun's displeasure. However, there's something strange about Jin Uk – despite his kindness toward Jay, suspicions begin to rise that Jin Uk may be involved in a murder and missing person incident. Is there a happy ending in store for Jay and Seong Hun, or will Jay's budding relationship with Jin Uk cost him an unspeakable price?

(Source: Viki)
788910.title: Eccentric Romance (Movie)

788920.synopsis:
Kang Yong Ho is the chairman of the Choiseong Group, a leading conglomerate in South Korea. He built the company by himself, and he is now known as the “God of Business”. One day, he has an unexpected accident. He collides with a young man named Hwang Jun Hyeon. Hwang Jun Hyeon is a soccer player who has just joined the League 1 team FC Choiseong. Due to the accident, Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul is swapped with soccer player Hwang Jun Hyeon's soul.

With Chairman Kang Yong Ho's soul in Hwang Jun Hyeon's body, he applies to the Choiseong Group as a new employee. He begins his unpredictable journey with his soul as an outstanding businessman and the young body of Hwang Jun Hyeon.

(Source: AsianWiki)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "New Employee Chairman Kang" (신입사원 강회장) by San Gyeong (산경).
788920.title: Reborn Rookie

788924.synopsis:
Follows Kong Yu Il, an ordinary job seeker who unexpectedly becomes the manager of top star Tak Mu I. Yu Il lives an unremarkable life, struggling with both employment and love, yet maintains a bright and optimistic outlook. Her everyday routine begins to change when she discovers that Tak Mu I is the number-one fan of a novel she wrote long ago.

Tak Mu I is a beloved top actor whose name alone represents a powerful brand. Behind his flawless public image, however, he suffers from emotional wounds caused by severe stalking. During a difficult period in his life, he encounters Kong Yu Il—the author whose novel once helped him overcome a past slump—and the two become connected through shared admiration and support.

As Yu Il and Mu I grow closer, they navigate an unexpected romance shaped by mutual fandom and healing. Their relationship unfolds alongside Kang Hui Su, a warm and talented star chef with a mysterious side, and Ju Da Hong, a free-spirited actress who has long admired Tak Mu I and naturally forms a rivalry with Kong Yu Il.

(Source: MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "One-Of-A-Kind Romance" (유일무이 로맨스) by Du Bu (두부).
788924.title: One of a Kind Romance

789036.synopsis:
Yeon Su was raised in a conservative family, where courtesy and discipline mean everything, making it somewhat difficult to learn about her true self. One day, she gets intertwined with a sex toy company and meets Dokgo Dal, who opens up a whole other world for her. While their love blossoms, Yeon Su not only learns about her emotional excitement but also acknowledges the importance of physical excitement that leads her to truly mature.

(Source: CJ ENM)
789036.title: Make Me Tingle

789130.synopsis:
Lee Ji Hyeok is a competent person, who is recognized both in work and love. He is proactive and cold-hearted, but he also has a sense of humor. Lee Ji Hyeok looks glamorous, but, after experiencing the lowest point of his life, he finds the true meaning of life. He has people around him, including Ji Eun O and Park Seong Jae. Ji Eun O has a bright and cheerful personality. She works as a cafe manager and an interior designer. She never loses her passion even during difficult times.

Once, Ji Eun O had a crush on Lee Ji Hyeok and she was rejected by him, but, even after that, she still stays by him. Park Seong Jae is Lee Ji Hyeok's friend. Park Seong Jae, who grew up in a wealthy family, is relaxed and well mannered, but he holds a deep feeling of loneliness inside. He feels a sense of connection with Lee Ji Hyeok and his family, but Park Seong Jae is torn between love and friendship.

(Source: AsianWiki)
789130.title: Our Golden Days

789132.synopsis:
VR Dating Company CEO, the love hater. Documentary Writer, who's unable to express or notice others feeling. This is sweet but quite bloody story of them overcoming traumas. It effectively combines the material of VR blind date with the romantic comedy genre that all generations around the world can relate to, presenting something new that has never been seen before.

Yun Bi A, a programmer who created an era of romance with Al that is 100% compatible with her, and 100% pure romantic. Han Seon Ho, a novel writer who sticks to analogue. And the unknown secrets that unfold before them.

(Source: WelCon.kocca.kr/en, youngcontents.com; edited by MyDramaList)
789132.title: Love Phobia

789134.synopsis:
In South Korea, military service is mandatory for all men. But a select few—like privileged medical students—can serve as public health doctors instead. This is the story of those privileged few. Do Ji Ui, a plastic surgeon, is assigned to Pyeondong-do, an isolated island no one wants to go to. From the very first day, ominous signs begin to appear. Can he survive a full year on this hellish island and make it out alive—or will the island break him before he can hold the line?

(Source: The Studio M)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Doctor Jonbeo" (존버닥터) by Kim Tae Pung (김태풍).
789134.title: Doctor on the Edge

789160.synopsis:
Se Yeong works as a secretary to the head of the fashion brand "Radical." Her boss, Su Hyeon, torments her harshly, but she always manages to complete her tasks with determination. Then one day, the silver-spoon brat Su Hyeon confesses, "You're the first woman I've ever fallen for!"
"I find you very strange, Director."

As a butterfly effect of this rejection, a villain moves in next door to Se Yeong.  Se Yeong, now having her neighbor as her boss, tries hard to avoid Su Hyeon, but his pursuit continues relentlessly. While trying to evade Su Hyeon's affections, Se Yeong gradually starts to feel drawn to him. The boss who seemed like a villain begins to help Se Yeong and wins her heart, and Su Hyeon also triumphs in an internal company competition with Se Yeong's help.

Their feelings grow alongside the company's success. However, Do Hyeon watches them with an indecipherable gaze, and Seo Hwi, who still has lingering feelings for Su Hyeon, becomes an obstacle for the couple.
Will Se Yeong and Su Hyeon be able to paint a happy future together?!

(Source: welcon.kocca.kr/en)
789160.title: The Villain Next Door

789270.synopsis:
Yu Bin, who has given up on actively seeking romance and believes true love will come naturally, spends a romantic night with Han Na after a blind date. To her surprise, when she goes to work the next day, she discovers that her new boss is none other than Han Na herself! 

From then on, the two are forced to navigate the delicate balance between work and romance, embarking on a sweet, thrilling, and heart-pounding office romance.

(Source: GagaOOLala)
789270.title: An Office Thing

789396.synopsis:
Kang Jae In is the youngest leader for a design team at YL Group and she comes from a wealthy family. She is married to Hwang Gi Chan, who works as a director at YL Group. Her life seems so ideal that she is the envy of many people. Nevertheless, Kang Jae In dreams of an ordinary and simple life, unlike her ambitious husband Hwang Gi Chan. An incident leads to Kang Jae In's life changing completely. Meanwhile, Kim Do Yun is an excellent thoracic surgeon. He is warm-hearted and easygoing, but he loses someone precious to him all of a sudden. He vows to take revenge.

(Source: AsianWiki)
789396.title: Queen's House

789420.synopsis:
Tells the story of a demon known as ‘No. 3375,’ who has lived for a long time with powerful abilities. After receiving a new mission, he heads to Korea. While staying at a hotel in a seaside village, he becomes entangled with a room attendant named Lee Deul Pan, and for the first time begins to experience unfamiliar emotions and attraction he cannot understand.

Having always gotten everything he desires, the demon has lived without ever understanding love—until he meets the human Lee Deul Pan, who begins to stir unexpected changes within him. As Deul Pan repeatedly crosses paths with “No. 3375,” now a VVVIP guest at her hotel, she finds her own heart gradually shifting in ways she never imagined.

(Source: MyDramaList)
789420.title: Long Vacation

789518.synopsis:
Tells the story of a bewitching creature who captivates humans and a human who draws in supernatural beings, meeting at the intersection of fate.

Koo Ja Hong, a top actress who captivates audiences with her outstanding acting skills and stunning visuals, is a two-thousand-year-old gumiho. Born with a talent for captivating others, she's driven by scandal. With her mysterious and powerful abilities, manipulating humans is a no-brainer. One day, she encounters Choi Seok, a unique human whose powers she can't control. Koo Ja Hong's fighting spirit and excitement are both palpable as she confronts this sinister man who threatens to render her powerless.

Choi Seok, a brave shaman and director of the Oseong Museum. Choi Seok, who always appears lighthearted and cheerful, actually possesses a special ability to see and feel the harsh realities of the world. He faces a turning point when he begins to feel an inexplicable interest in a gumiho who freely invades his territory.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
789518.title: Human X Gumiho

789540.synopsis:
The story is about a genius doctor who dares to challenge the realm of God, and a woman whose brain suddenly fails, slowly losing her soul.

Top star Mo Mo falls into a coma after a sudden accident. Unable to bear watching her daughter lie there helplessly, her mother, Ran Hui, gives up her own life for the sake of the beautiful Mo Mo. Then begins a strange romance involving Ju Sin, the man who once loved Mo Mo, and the men who love her now.

When we love someone, what exactly are we loving, the soul or the body? If another soul were to inhabit the body of the person you loved, which would you choose? This story explores people who cross forbidden lines in the name of love, and the destruction that follows.

(Source: Korean = TV Chosun || Translation = MyDramaList)
789540.title: Doctor Shin

789718.synopsis:
Danny, a popular internet streamer, finds his daily life increasingly disrupted by anonymous stalking. One day, a strange man named Jeong Hun suddenly appears at his doorstep, and suspicious situations start to unfold…

"So, are you really the stalker?"
"Is this what you wanted? Then touch me."

Is it just a misunderstanding—or a calculated approach?

(Source: flyingpenguinKR YouTube)
789718.title: Only for Fans: The Stalker

789724.synopsis:
After quitting her job, Yu Mi became a star writer at the peak of her fame, with her "Writer Cell" taking charge over "Love Cell." But the sweetness of success doesn’t last forever. Her days soon turn dull and monotonous until a man named Sun Rok steps into her life. Facing this younger man, Yu Mi discovers a new kind of love — unexpected, disarming, and deeply stirring.

Once a common to-go girl in her 30s, Kim Yu Mi is now a celebrated romance novelist. But with no more new goals or challenges, her cells have fallen asleep, leaving her days lifeless—until Sun Rok appears. Yu Mi learns that even a star romance writer can be a total rookie when it comes to real love.

Sin Sun Rok, an editor in his 20s at Julie Publishing, is all about facts, logic, and boundaries, feeling perfectly relaxed when staying home alone. But as Yu Mi starts to invade his world, he draws a line—only to find himself slowly, irresistibly, falling for her.

(Source: CJ ENM)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Yumi's Cells" (유미의 세포들) by Lee Dong Geon (이동건).
789724.title: Yumi's Cells Season 3

789816.synopsis:
A man who dreamed of becoming a national judo representative, Jun U, is defeated in a single match by Min Jae, who appeared like a comet.

(Source: Shortime)
789816.title: Ippon: Hold Me Tight

aka: tvN O'PENing: My Daughter’s Friend’s Mother
tvN O'PENing: My Daughter’s Friend’s Mom
789828.synopsis:
About Gi Jun , a single working dad who suddenly divorces and meets his former subordinate, Hui Jin, in front of a kindergarten, where their relationship is reversed.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
789828.title: tvN O'PENing: Mission the Birthday Invitation

789874.synopsis:
It tells the story of a married couple in their 5th year of marriage, about to get divorced, and their conflict over the 'cat rights' of a cat that is like a child to them. They had difficulty conceiving but adopted a stray cat and lived like family, but eventually decided to get a divorce. 

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
789874.title: tvN O'PENing: The Catstody War

789878.synopsis:
Divorce lawyer Cha Eun Gyeong, a star attorney who is practically made for divorce, and experienced lawyer Kang Hye Seong, who is passionate about divorce, become each other’s good partners in this satisfying, cathartic divorce story.

(Source: Korean = SBS || Translation = MyDramaList)
789878.title: Good Partner Season 2

790120.synopsis:
An electrifying romantic comedy about a man whose artificial heart is running out of battery and a woman who has the power to recharge him. 

Baek Ho Rang is a flawless third-generation chaebol heir fighting a ruthless succession battle to inherit his family’s conglomerate. But beneath his perfect facade lies a deadly secret: his artificial heart is running out of battery, and showing any weakness could cost him his empire. Enter Na Bo Bae, a romance screenwriter whose body has conducted high-voltage electricity ever since a childhood accident, leaving her unable to touch anyone without shocking them.

When their paths cross and Ho Rang realizes he is completely immune to her currents, he offers her an irresistible contract. By joining forces, she can finally jumpstart her locked-down love life, and he can keep his heart beating long enough to win his corporate war. But as their high-voltage partnership sparks unexpected feelings, can they recharge his battery before they burn out their hearts?

(Source: Netflix; edited by ElfinieKarl at MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Charge Me Up" (나를 충전해줘) by Hae Beon (해번).
790120.title: Take Charge of My Heart

790156.synopsis:
"Where dreams and hopes become reality.“ Oceanland, a newly opened casino in Korea, now allows locals to enter. However, behind its glamorous exterior, the world of the casino is a battlefield against troublesome customers and lingering spirits.

As the casino's revenue continues to decline, Oceanland is planning to host the largest Hold'em tournament to turn the tide... In the midst of this, Oceanland dealer Jung Geon Hwa dreams of a simple marriage with her boyfriend Choi U Seung, who is also a detective. But Geon Hwa, who seems ordinary, has a long-hidden secret: she can detect lies when she drinks alcohol! 

Geon Hwa has sealed her ability due to the pain of her family leaving her because of it. However, when a real estate scam causes her to lose the deposit on her newlywed home and her plans start to crumble, she decides to use her ability to win money at gambling to make up for the loss.

(Source: Welcon.kocca.kr/en; edited by MyDramaList)
790156.title: The Dealer

aka: Adultery Is Not the Problem Right Now
An Affair Is Not the Problem Right Now
It's Not a Matter of Infidelity Right Now
The Affair Is Not the Problem Right Now
790158.synopsis:
Gyeong Hui is an influencer and business owner who is adored for the lovely image of her family. Her interior business is thriving, and she is trying to get closer to Su Jeong, the owner of a skin‑care clinic next door, because she realizes Su Jeong could help her secure an investment that would take her business to the next level.

One day, after hearing rumors that her husband Jae Hyeong is having an affair, she follows him — only to be shocked when she discovers him handling a dead body. His explanation is even more devastating. “Are you saying my daughter Ye Ji hurt someone? So the affair isn’t the only problem?”

To protect their success and their family, Gyeong Hui and Jae Hyeong bury the body in the garden of their mansion to cover up the accident. However, later that night, they receive a message: “I recorded everything you did yesterday.

(Source: Welcon.kocca.kr/en; edited by MyDramaList)
790158.title: The Affair Was Just the Beginning

790280.synopsis:
After the death of his genius jazz pianist older brother, Han Tae I loses his will to live. He finds transfer student Yun Se Heon, who plays jazz reminiscent of his brother, to be an unwelcome presence. Se Heon also suspects Tae I of having a suspicious relationship with his friend, Seo Do Yun. Both are assigned to the same group for a performance evaluation, and as they practice, their emotions become more complex. However, things get complicated when Song Ju Ha, a suspended senior, returns to school, stirring tensions between Tae I and Se Heon.

(Source: MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Jazz for Two" (재즈처럼) by Clarju (클라쥬).
~~ Release dates: Sep 7, 2024 (Festival) || Oct 2, 2024 (Cinema)
790280.title: Jazz for Two the Movie

790394.synopsis:
Kang Ma Ri has always longed for her father, but her search takes an unexpected turn when three men suddenly step into her life. Lee Pung Ju, a strict but caring doctor, becomes tied to her through hidden family secrets. Kang Min Bo, the father who once raised her, returns after decades abroad, determined to reunite with the daughter he lost. And Jin Gi Sik, her affectionate uncle, insists on playing a larger role in her life, leaving Ma Ri caught in the middle of a chaotic paternity scandal.
