As she struggles to untangle the truth, Ma Ri begins a clumsy but heartfelt romance with her senior colleague, Lee Gang Se. What starts as an awkward relationship soon deepens into a supportive partnership, with Gang Se standing firmly by her side as she faces secrets and hardships that could shake her family apart.

Adding to the turmoil is Ma Ri’s fiery mother, Ju Si Ra, whose impulsive nature and unresolved past with Min Bo bring new storms into their lives. Both a troublemaker and a loving parent, Si Ra pushes Ma Ri toward difficult choices with her unpredictable actions, forcing mother and daughter to confront what truly defines love, family, and forgiveness.

(Source: MyDramaList)
790394.title: Marie and Her Three Daddies

790448.synopsis:
Jin U, who came to the boarding school, has one goal: to get into a Korean university. But Eun Hyeok, who is completely uncontrollable, keeps crossing the line.

(Source: Shortcha)
790448.title: No Dating at Boarding School

790552.synopsis:
Seo Jin U, who died in an accident after being sidelined at work, suddenly wakes up in the past?! He's returned to the time before his idea was stolen and decides to quit… But when Executive Director Baek Ui Hyeon says just one thing, he ends up becoming the project lead instead!

(Source: Shortime)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Junkneuni Toesahagetseumnida, Isanim!" (죽느니 퇴사하겠습니다, 이사님!) by Bori Mustache (보리수염).
790552.title: I'd Rather Quit Than Die, Director!: Uncut Version

790640.synopsis:
To get a job in Seoul, Jin U Hyeok ended up living at the house of his mom’s friend’s son, On Yu, a successful writer. And that’s how it all began...

(Source: Sukfilm YouTube)
790640.title: Never Fair

790642.synopsis:
Two university students with differing personalities and boundaries try to navigate living together.

(Source: r/GirlsLove Reddit)
790642.title: Kiss the Hater

aka: Everyone Is Fighting Their Own Worthlessness
790724.synopsis:
The "Group of Eight" is a gang of filmmaker friends who met as juniors and seniors in their university film club. They've since built successful careers in the industry—all except Hwang Dong Man. An aspiring director who hasn't debuted in twenty years. To mask it, he overcompensates by dominating conversations and lobbing harsh critiques at everyone. He tries to pass as a mentor, but his constant chatter wears people down. This behavior causes his friends to become frustrated with him. Despite Hwang's struggles with his perceived failure, his friends continue to support him.

(Source: Wikipedia)
790724.title: We Are All Trying Here

790848.synopsis:
COVID-19, which had terrorized humanity, has finally ended, and the WHO has defined it as an endemic. However, Jung Yu Hyeon, a professor of infectious diseases at a Korean university hospital, is astonished to face a patient showing symptoms of a new virus.

The virus first infects the brain and heart, then causes the infected person to become brain-dead. After this, the infected people wake up as zombies. This is the worst virus that signals the end of humanity.

The virus controls the human brain and has a very strong survival instinct. Recognizing this, the government and the president decide that the virus is stronger than a nuclear weapon and proceed with a research project to create the virus as a biochemical weapon. In the end, they succeed in the mass production of the virus, but it is leaked into the middle of Seoul during a raid by intelligence agencies and terrorist groups from around the world.

The era of “New Humanity" that was born with viruses has just begun.

(Source: Story Park)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Post-Pandemic" (포스트 팬데믹) by Lee Nak Jun (이낙준)
790848.title: Post Pandemic

790854.synopsis:
Depicts the story of Lee Dong Min, who is a former idol group member with good looks, talent, and intelligence. He tasted success in the competitive music industry, but just before a major music broadcast, he suddenly disappears. Years later, he reappears as a PD in the entertainment industry.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
790854.title: End up in Inkigayo

79099.synopsis:
Cha Mu Sik runs a casino bar, only to flee to the Philippines due to a crackdown by the National Tax Service. He launches a full-fledged casino business and strategizes winning over the political and business circles in the Philippines. However, he is suddenly framed as a suspect in Min Seok Joon's death and is tracked by Oh Seung Hoon of the Korean Desk. Betrayal is rampant in the presence of money. Who will be the last person standing?

(Source: Hulu)

~~ Co-production with the U.S.A.
79099.title: Big Bet

791006.synopsis:
Depicts the story of Cha Ji Yun, a seventh-year office worker stuck in a career slump, who chooses her prickly boss, Kang Si U, as the “lesser evil” to avoid the “worst.” Together, they grow to become each other’s irreplaceable “best.”

Kang Si U, the direct supervisor of Cha Ji Yun and a handsome man who has everything except a pleasant personality. Kang Si U has striking looks, an impressive physique, and a lifestyle fit for a self-care textbook, but his cold, blunt manner has earned him the nickname “the company’s worst grump.” He becomes tangled in an unusual way with Ji Yun.

Cha Ji Yun, a hardworking professional worn down by her job and by life itself. Known for her skilled hands and exceptional work instincts, she handles tasks with ease and has earned the trust of her colleagues. However, she is facing a slump in both work and love. Into her ordinary life barges her prickly boss, Kang Si U.

(Source: Soompi)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “I'm Going to Work Tomorrow!" (내일도 출근!) by McQueen Studio (맥퀸스튜디오).
791006.title: See You at Work Tomorrow!

aka: The Tale of Lady Ok Making
791650.synopsis:
The behind-the-scenes footage from "The Tale of Lady Ok" (2024).

(Source: MyDramaList)
791650.title: The Tale of Lady Ok: Behind the Scenes

791822.synopsis:
In the exam-obsessed hell of Daechi-dong, where jealousy and desire boil over, every trick imaginable is used in the pursuit of grades. After students swallow a forbidden “stimulant” to boost their scores, they begin to hear the whispers of the dead. In this exam-driven inferno turned into a playground for evil spirits, an exorcist priest, Antonio, risks his very soul to save the children.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
791822.title: Excitatio

aka: The Youngest Son of a Chaebol Family 2
The Youngest Son of a Chaebol Family Season 2
791890.synopsis:
Depicts the success, love, and desire for power of the main characters who unfold overseas as the stage against the background of a global company.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)

791890.title: Reborn Rich Season 2

791952.synopsis:
As they reach their one-year anniversary, Min Jun prepares a gift and Jin Hwan arranges a dinner. Jin Hwan suggests that the two move in together, but Min Jun is apprehensive about the future. Will these two finally be able to come to an understanding after one year of being together?

(Source: GagaOOLala)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Eul's Love" (을의 연애) by Moscareto (모스카레토).
791952.title: Business as Usual Special

792446.synopsis:
A court romance fantasy depicting the events that unfold as Empress Latil of the Tarium Empire takes in male concubines to maintain her throne.

(Source: Korean = NamuWiki || Translation = Cora at MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel series “Men of the Harem" (하렘의 남자들) written by Alpha Tart (알파타르트) and illustrated by Chirun (치런).
792446.title: Men of the Harem

792448.synopsis:
Yun Ga Min and the now even more tightly bonded Study Group members will face a massive evil force that threatens not only Yuseong Technical High School but students across the entire nation.

Through a “cruel yet exhilarating study session,” this season delves into the members’ growing pains, untold pasts, and the hidden secrets behind this overwhelming enemy.

(Source: Korean = Celuv Media, MK스포츠  || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Study Group" (스터디그룹) written by Shin Hyung Wook (신형욱) and illustrated by Ryu Seung Yeon (류승연).
792448.title: Study Group Season 2

792640.synopsis:
It tells the bewitching story of a man and woman who claim to be “untempted at forty” but end up falling for each other. Having reached 40 without truly experiencing the flavor of life or love, their dormant hearts are unexpectedly reignited. A star anchor struggling with early-onset male menopause teams up with his former rival, a scrappy writer, to save a last-place-rated TV program, only to revive their long-forgotten romantic spark in the process.

Na I Jun, a star news anchor at a broadcasting station. Raised without hardship in an ordinary middle-class family, he earned a perfect score on the college entrance exam and became the youngest anchor in the network’s history. However, at 40, he suffers from early-onset male menopause, causing his self-esteem to plummet.

Seo Hae Yun is a writer for the news division. Having worked at various broadcasting stations for over a decade, earning the nickname “third-rate writer” for obsessing over ratings and only covering sensational and gossip-driven news. She has a quick temper and finds it exhausting to use her head, making her the kind of character who can’t keep up any “push-and-pull” romantic tension with a man for more than half a day.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
792640.title: Fascinating Romance

792644.synopsis:
On the verge of divorce, Kang Tae Ju's life is shattered when his wife, Ko Se Yun, is kidnapped. As he desperately searches for her, he is implicated in a murder-for-hire case and becomes a wanted fugitive. Hunted by the police, he finds himself locked in a deadly battle with No Man Hui, a seemingly ordinary man whose calm exterior conceals a terrifying cruelty.

As Se Yun struggles to escape her captors, she encounters the mysterious Kim Gyeong Ae, whose kindness hides an unsettling aura and whose role in the case remains uncertain. With hidden motives and dangerous secrets gradually coming to light, Tae Ju is pushed to increasingly perilous extremes and must uncover the truth behind the kidnapping before he loses the woman he is about to leave.

(Source: MyDramaList)
792644.title: The Husband

792684.synopsis:
After retiring from gymnastics, Han Ji Won thought his biggest challenges were behind him. Turns out, winning Olympic medals was easy compared to surviving university as a painfully shy ex-superstar. Enter Kwon Jeong U — campus heartthrob, basketball star, and a whole new world of trouble wrapped up in a perfect smile. But just when Ji Won thinks he has Jeong U figured out, he discovers a surprisingly sweet side beneath that cold exterior. Can this unlikely duo overcome their differences and stick the landing on their budding romance?

(Source: Korean = lezhinus || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Ball Boy Tactics" (볼보이 택틱스) by Ji Seung Hyeon (지승현).
792684.title: Ball Boy Tactics

792688.synopsis:
Yoo Do Ha never thought his quiet, uneventful life would suddenly turn into a romantic storm. At twenty-seven, he’s never dated, never kissed, never even thought much about love, until the day everything falls apart. Falsely accused at work and unjustly fired, he’s left feeling humiliated and lost. Then, as if fate were teasing him, a strange fortune teller crosses his path and says, “From now on, men will fall for you, and you’ll never know peace again.” Do Ha doesn’t take it seriously, until it actually happens!

Three men, each completely different from the other, begin to appear in his life as if pulled by some invisible string. His former boss, Jeon Yeon Sang, stands by him with quiet strength, the only one who believes he’s innocent. The charming and bold Yeon Ha Ram flirts without fear, turning every conversation into a teasing game. And his childhood friend Taek Gyeon, who’s always known him best, starts to act… strangely different. Then, one fateful night, a drunken stumble leads to an accidental kiss that turns Do Ha’s world upside down, but he can’t remember who it was.

Now, surrounded by unexpected affection and growing confusion, Do Ha finds himself caught in the middle of a romance he never asked for — a trap woven out of peach blossom luck, fate, and maybe… his very first love.

(Source: MyDramaList)
792688.title: Peach Trap

792888.synopsis:
Late at night, Geon Ha and Gwang Min are left alone in the club room. They bicker over their assignment and end up dozing off...  But when they wake up— There’s a dead body lying right next to them?!

“…Hey, don’t tell me you did this?”
“Why are you asking me?!”

And now, a confession on top of all this…?!

“Why… why now, of all times, sunbae?”
“If not now… you’ll just run away again.”

An assignment, a body, and a confession…
How much more can they handle in one night?!

(Souce: flyingpenguinKR YouTube)
792888.title: Don't Confess Next to a Corpse

aka: Bitch X Rich: In the Drawing Class
793036.synopsis:
Cheong A is the most popular girl at her elite, private high school. She's used to getting her way and being fawned over. But her perfect life comes crashing down when Re Na transfers to her school. While trying to bring Re Na under her thumb, Cheong A discovers that she is secretly the daughter of a powerful political family, and Re Na discovers that Cheong A's glamorous life has been a lie!

(Source: Vigloo)
793036.title: Bitch X Rich: In the Drawing Class

793044.synopsis:
South Korea can no longer be considered a drug-free country. The drug epidemic is so widespread that meth has been detected in sewage collected from sewage treatment plants. When the government realizes that the police force is not enough to solve the problem, they bring in Kim San, a top NIS agent.

Through his investigation, San discovers the largest meth lab in South Korea since the country’s founding. And it turns out that the Triad is behind it all. San, determined to stop the drug at its source, travels to Taiwan. As he fights his way to the truth, he realizes that the operation is a lot bigger than it seems. The Triad have been planning to move their entire drug manufacturing operation to Korea, funded by none other than the Japanese Yakuza.

To protect their investment and assets, the Yakuza and Triad join forces. San stands tall against all of them. He’s ready to crush them all, one by one. But he may be in too deep over his head.

(Source: Welcon.kocca.kr/en)
793044.title: Barons

793046.synopsis:
An emotional transference romance that unfolds as a woman who denies empathy and a man who bears the burden of empathy come to share each other’s emotions.

Cha Eun Hwan, a man who bears others' emotions excessively. He is a psychological counseling expert who has gained widespread popularity for his unique counseling methods. However, after becoming entangled in an unexpected incident, his everyday life and emotional balance begin to unravel. As he falls into despair, a figure connected to his past appears, bringing changes to both his life and his emotions.

Yoo Ji An, a former girl group member who was once called the “Nation’s Idol” and enjoyed explosive popularity, is now working as an actress. Having lived her life suppressing her emotions under her mother’s strict control since childhood, Ji An faces a crisis due to controversy over her acting skills, stemming from her lack of empathy. She then meets Cha Eun Hwan, a psychological counseling expert, and unexpectedly experiences “emotional transference.” Through this experience, she begins to rediscover her lost emotions and grow as a person.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
793046.title: Love in Sync

793070.synopsis:
In Kwon Do Hyeok’s life, nothing brings comfort—everything is just confusion and emptiness, and he is the emotionless CEO of SY Entertainment, a man who doesn’t even shed a tear when physically hurt. Because of unresolved insomnia from long-standing PTSD, he visits a psychiatrist, who prescribes an unusual cure: “There is a woman whose voice can soothe your nerves. She’s listed under ‘XX Syndrome’ if you don’t find her soon, the side effects may get serious.”

Around the same time, Do Hyeok’s father, notorious for his complicated private life, becomes interested in a new indie band, leading to an album appearing on Do Hyeok’s desk. The moment he realizes the woman’s voice on the album is identical to the voice engraved in his mind, his heart begins to pound uncontrollably—she is the woman whose voice saved him in his darkest moments.

But when his father sets his sights on the same woman as a potential mistress, Do Hyeok must find her first. As he searches for this mysterious woman with the “healing voice,” his emotionless existence transforms into a chaotic romantic life he never expected—and that’s when his obsessive tastes begin to reveal themselves. 

A thrilling, comedic, and melodramatic chase for love begins.

(Source: Korean = GodinMedia || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel “What a Boss Wants" (보스의 노골적 취향) by Sikeukeu (시크크).
793070.title: What a Boss Wants

793102.synopsis:
Gi Jun, once the ace of the internal audit team, is now stuck handling petty office scandals—all thanks to his manager, In A. One day, he receives an anonymous tip: In A is involved in an inappropriate relationship at work. Digging into her secret for revenge, Gi Jun instead finds himself drawn to her. And as In A shares her secret with him, she begins to wonder whether Gi Jun might be the one person who can help her overcome her dark past and finally find happiness. An office romance quietly blossoms within the very duty meant to chase down office affairs and corruption.

(Source: CJ ENM)
793102.title: Filing for Love

793106.synopsis:
Seo Jin U, who died in an accident after being sidelined at work, suddenly wakes up in the past?! He's returned to the time before his idea was stolen and decides to quit… But when Executive Director Baek Ui Hyeon says just one thing, he ends up becoming the project lead instead!

(Source: Shortime)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Junkneuni Toesahagetseumnida, Isanim!" (죽느니 퇴사하겠습니다, 이사님!) by Bori Mustache (보리수염).
793106.title: I'd Rather Quit Than Die, Director!

793146.synopsis:
Since birth, Na Gyum was an exceptionally talented painter. However, though he had published a few collections under a pseudonym, he had decided to quit painting. Then Seung Ho, a young nobleman, barges into his life. An infamous tyrant notorious for his insatiable lust for creativity, Seung Ho forces Na Gyum to become his private painter. However, the nights that await Na Gyum are beyond anything he could have imagined…

(Source: lezhinus.com) ~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Painter of the Night" (야화첩) by Byeonduck (변덕).
793146.title: Painter of the Night

793152.synopsis:
This season follows the dynamic second half of Private-turned-Corporal Park Min Seok's military life as he struggles with endless concerns after being promoted to corporal.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web animation "New Recruit" (신병) by Jang Bbi Jju (장삐쭈).
~~ Versions: 12 episodes (TV) || 24 episodes (Online)
793152.title: New Recruit Season 4: Sabotage

793172.synopsis:
A romance between a student and his teacher. Where will their journey take them?

(Source: MyDramaList)
793172.title: Real Love

793188.synopsis:
Trainee idol Kim I Jin had his crucial debut performance ruined when narcotics detective Seong Han Gyeol stormed the scene chasing a drug dealer. Thinking they would never meet again, they were shocked to discover they were now stepsiblings with no blood relation. Furious, I Jin decides to take revenge by seducing Han Gyeol, only to find himself falling for him. Thus begins the heart-racing, borderline forbidden romance between pseudo-siblings.

(Source: WeTV)
793188.title: Something More than Brothers

793218.synopsis:
A story of conflict, growth, and love begins when Yeon U, still holding on to past feelings for his senior U Jin, finds out that U Jin is now engaged to his sister.

(Source: Shortime)
793218.title: It's You

79341.synopsis:
Kang In Su is a passionate street singer whose life revolves around music. With the help of his loyal friend Min Sung, who shares his performances online, In Soo keeps chasing his dream of turning his talent into a career, despite the setbacks.

Meanwhile, Yoon Sang Yi, a keyboardist at a top record label, stumbles across In Soo’s videos and is instantly drawn to his voice. Believing he’s discovered something special, Sang Yi invites In Soo to join a new artist development program. In Soo takes the leap and moves into the company’s shared residence, where he and Sang Yi grow closer.

As they navigate life under the same roof, their bond deepens into something more. But with rising emotions come unexpected challenges. Will their growing connection survive the pressures that come with ambition, vulnerability and love?

(Source: Viki)
79341.title: Wish You: Your Melody From My Heart

794044.synopsis:
Il Jo, an unfortunate illegitimate son, gets abused by his half-brother Seo Jeong In at their father’s funeral and ends up relying on his cousin, Seo Jeong Han. One night, Il Jo impulsively kisses Jeong Han. Soon after,  is hospitalized with gallstones, and the prickly Jeong Han pays the 4-million-won surgery bill for him.

Jeong Han then tells him to “pay it back with his body” and proposes a contract that basically states all of Il Jo’s rights belong to him. Il Jo ends up living in Jeong Han’s house and serving him.

Jeong Han, who was always indifferent, slowly finds himself drawn to Il Jo’s innocence and desperate devotion. Their relationship grows deeper, both physically and emotionally, and Jeong Han begins to develop an intense obsession and possessiveness toward him.

(Source: Korean = Wavve || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Thundercloud Rainstorm" (천둥구름 비바람) by Caesim (체심).
794044.title: Thundercloud Rainstorm

794290.synopsis:
Depicts the story of Min Yeong Ju, head of a publishing company whose hands have shaped dozens of bestsellers over the past decade. Intelligent and elegant, she possesses a sharp intellect and a deep sense of empathy for people. Yet when faced with something she believes is wrong, she can turn unflinchingly cold and decisive — every inch the capable CEO.

On the day she celebrates her 60th birthday alone, the wealthy divorcée meets Jung Jae Hui, a 33-year-old freelance designer with striking looks and an irresistible charm that is difficult to escape once you fall under it, at an art museum — an encounter that begins an unexpected connection between them.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Remake of the British TV series “Gold Digger" [2019].
794290.title: Gold Digger

794306.synopsis:
To marry the heir of the Geonhyang Group, Cha Jeong Won enters a wealthy family under a false identity, borrowing her friend's name. However, the woman who appears before her as her mother-in-law, Han Hye Ra, is none other than Jeong Won's biological mother. Hye Ra abandoned her daughter to escape poverty and gain power. Jeong Won, scarred by a father framed for murder and a mother who left her, confronts Hye Ra as her future daughter-in-law. But just before the wedding, Jeong Won learns Hye Ra is her birth mother and vows revenge. A fierce war between two women continues amidst lies and betrayal. In a world where everything collapses with lies, only blood is real. Will the truth that the blood reveals trample on the lies and win, or will it be swallowed by another lie?

(Source: Kocowa)
794306.title: A Graceful Liar

794494.synopsis:
One wrong number can change everything.

Yoo I Seop is a quiet, reserved young man whose world shifts when he receives a call from an unknown number—one that wasn't meant for him. On the other end is Han U Tae, a bold and mysterious stranger whose voice becomes the beginning of something neither of them expected.

What starts as an accidental connection grows into something deeper as they continue to talk, night after night. But both carry emotional scars, and neither of them has been entirely honest about who they are—or what they're hiding. When past traumas resurface and feelings grow complicated, they must confront their own fears before the line between comfort and pain disappears.

Can a mistake lead to something real? Or are they destined to be two strangers, forever just a voice on the other end?

Sometimes, the wrong number is the right person.

(Source: MyDramaList)
tags: Homosexual Falling For A Straight Person
794494.title: Wrong Number

794566.synopsis:
A reverse romantic comedy about a "shotgun romance" that begins with a one-night stand between a man and a woman who both vowed never to get married in this lifetime.

Kang Du Jun, a seemingly perfect second-generation chaebol from head to toe. Having decided that marriage was not in the cards for this life, he lives for his remaining family and company in place of his deceased older brother. However, his life takes an unexpected turn when he becomes entangled with Jang Hui Won after a wild one-night fling.

Jang Hui Won, a career woman who scores 100 in work but 0 in romance. Scarred by her parents’ divorce and a harsh upbringing under a cold, critical mother, she has shut herself off from the idea of marriage and embraced singlehood by choice. But her carefully structured life faces an unforeseen twist following that one impulsive night.

(Source: kdramacasting X)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Positively Yours" (아기가 생겼어요) written by Lee Jeong (이정) and illustrated by Still (티르스).
794566.title: Positively Yours

794578.synopsis:
A youth comedy-investigation drama dealing with the issue of social recluses. It follows Tae Baek Ho, who loses his dream of becoming a police officer due to a violent incident and later joins an unofficial civilian group called the “Reclusive Masters Foundation.”

The story unfolds as he helps solve different cases involving recluses in an omnibus format, with each episode focusing on a new individual. The series is said to be based on a real company that supports social recluses, called “Not a Scary Company.”

(Source: Korean = NamuWiki || Translation = MyDramaList)
794578.title: The Hidden Hikikomori Master: Tae Baek Ho

794582.synopsis:
A coming-of-age journey of a young woman breaking free from the illusions of first love. Blending revenge, personal growth, friendship, family, and romance, it tells the story of Gong Mi Rae, who may be clumsy in love but is more sincere than anyone else. Through the pain of real-life relationships, she discovers not only the challenges of love but also the deeper love for herself.

(Source: TIFFCOM)
794582.title: Someday of Me

794782.synopsis:
A noir drama that unfolds against the backdrop of Jeju Island, delving into the fierce rivalry among three influential families the Bus, the Yangs, and the Kos — as they fight to protect their lineage and legacy. 

The story centers on three powerful clans: the Bu family, who dominate Jeju through pig farming and the horse racing industry; the Yang family in Jeju City, who are expanding through real estate development; and the Ko family in Seogwipo, who once flourished via the casino business but have since faded. All three families engage in a brutal power struggle over their territorial and business interests.

(Source: Kbizoom)
794782.title: Kin and Sin

794784.synopsis:
A new concept mystery love triangle where the female protagonist, O Seol Rem, who entered college to find her fiancé who disappeared at a game wedding, searches for an 'online male protagonist' and finds 'real love'.

(Source: HanCinema)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Namju Search" (남주서치) by Janbi (잔비).
794784.title: Where’s My Hero?

794790.synopsis:
Yoo Bo Na appears to be an ordinary working mother in her 30s, juggling family life with her husband and daughter. But behind her everyday facade, she is "Kingfisher," a legendary sniper who hunts down ruthless criminals that have escaped the law. After returning from a three-year childcare leave, Bo Na resumes her dangerous double life, struggling to balance motherhood, marriage, and her deadly mission.

As her investigative journalist husband Kwon Tae Seong unknowingly inches closer to discovering Kingfisher's true identity, and determined detective Lee Dong Jin relentlessly pursues the elusive vigilante, Bo Na finds herself trapped between family, justice, and survival. With the help of her loyal ally Kim Bong Pal, she must navigate a world where one mistake could destroy both her secret life and the family she cherishes.

(Source: MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "A Bona Fide Killer" (유부녀 킬러) written by Yun and illustrated by Gum Doong (검둥).
794790.title: A Bona Fide Killer

794930.synopsis: ~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Namnam" (남남) by Jeong Young Ryong (정영룡).
794930.title: Not Others Season 2

794932.synopsis:
Federal Informant ‘Baek I Su’ and a criminal gang’s boss, ‘Baek Do Gyeong’ are twin brothers.

With the same faces the two twin brothers have lived different lives until now. Baek I Su, who’s been betrayed by the gang, throws away his identity to become his brother. This federal agent is soon to become the gang’s boss…!

(Source: MangaUpdates)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Mr. Baek" (백XX) by Byeongjang (병장) and Park Tae Jun (박태준).
794932.title: Baek XX

795122.synopsis:
Yeo Eun Ho and Cha Do Hyeon have been friends all their lives. After 19 years, Eun Ho seems to have a good grasp on Do Hyeon, even knowing that his “perfect” image at school is a façade. But what Eun Ho is absolutely oblivious to is the fact that Do Hyeon has had an obsessive crush on him for years. Though Do Hyeon has been able to keep it a secret in order to slowly ease his way into Eun Ho’s heart, the sudden arrival of a new student named Kwon Yi Hyeon throws a wrench into his plans. What will Do Hyeon do to keep Eun Ho by his side? And will Eun Ho ever realize his best friend’s feelings for him?

(Source: Batoto)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Summer" (하절기) by Iiromill (이로밀).
795122.title: Summertime

795204.synopsis:
Nam Da Reum  gets a job at APPELLO, a fashion platform company connected to Lee Chan, an idol turned actor she has loved for years. But instead of the fan life she dreamed of, she keeps clashing with the strict workaholic CEO Kang Ha Gi, begins to misunderstand the strange bond between Ha Gi and Chan, and gets pulled into a secret she believes she must protect.

Set in a stylish startup workplace, the series unfolds as a lively romantic comedy about career growth, romantic confusion, and a complicated love triangle.

(Source: CJ ENM)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “My Oppa Is an Idol" (우리 오빠는 아이돌) by Seong Eun (성은).
795204.title: My Bias, My Boss

79525.synopsis:
Sum is a developer for the social-connecting app "Somebody." Even though she has difficulty communicating with other people, she is friends with Mok Won and Ki Eun. Her friend Ki Eun works as a detective.

A murder takes place, and the app "Somebody" is involved in the murder case. Architectural designer Yoon O appears in front of Sum and her friends. Yoon O is an attractive man, but he seems to be hiding something. Meanwhile, Ki Eun investigates the murder case with the help of Mok Won.

(Source: AsianWiki)

~~ Adapted from the novel “American Psycho” by Brett Easton Ellis.
~~ Release dates: Oct 6, 2022 (Festival) || Nov 18, 2022 (Netflix)

79525.title: Somebody

795258.synopsis:
Set against the wave of democratization and cultural modernization that swept through South Korea in the early 1990s, the series centers on a middle-class family concealing a treasonous secret. Though appearing to be ordinary citizens to their friends, neighbors, and even their own children, Kim Myeong Jun—an elite North Korean spy who has been living in South Korea for over a decade while hiding his true identity—and Yun Hwa Gyeong, a North Korean spy who has settled in South Korea as his carefully disguised wife, are in fact operatives working to destabilize the South from within.

As the series unfolds, the pair are pulled between their allegiance to their homeland, their sense of self, and the bonds they have formed as a family, while Cha Gi Seok, a relentless counterintelligence detective and former violent crimes unit officer who moves in next door, edges ever closer to exposing them.

(Source: Variety; edited by MyDramaList)

~~ Remake of the American TV series "The Americans" [2013].
795258.title: The Koreans

aka: The Crazy Guy in the District
The Crazy Guy in This District
このエリアのクレイジーX
79527.synopsis:
Two individuals with painful pasts navigate a complex journey of hurt and healing while falling in love.

No Hwi O, a detective in Gangnam’s violent crimes division, faces a sudden breakdown, becoming overwhelmed by uncontrollable anger.

Lee Min Gyeong, once a successful woman, is shattered by a traumatic event, leading her into delusions and a life of isolation, unable to trust others, and inadvertently causing anger in those around her.

(Source: MyDramaList)
79527.title: Mad for Each Other

795472.synopsis:
In a quiet village called Sae-dongne, retired killers live together in secrecy.
​
No resident shall ever use violence against civilians— except when the safety of Sae-dongne is at stake. But a storm is brewing as a massive new city development project sweeps through, led by the ruthless giant construction company, Kangsan Construction. Now, the village’s elders... former assassins, all must band together to protect their home. Can Sae-dongne survive the onslaught and keep its peace?

(Source: thestudiom.co.kr)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "New Neighborhood" (새동네) by Im Seong Hun (임성훈).
795472.title: Sae-dongne

795540.synopsis:
The last thing that introverted freelance designer Yun Oh could've expected was that going to receive a package that he didn't even remember ordering would kick off his relationship with the chatty delivery man Tae In, who continues to show up at his door, claiming he can see a lot of kindness past Yun Oh's cold and silent exterior. Yun Oh can't help but feel anxious about their daily encounters...or is it eagerness, actually?

(Source: SolySnivy at MyDramaList)
795540.title: Delivered

795714.synopsis:
U Gyo struggles with anorgasmia, and meets the therapist Hui Su. A touch-based therapy begins... and grows more intimate with each session.

(Source: STRONGBERRY YouTube)
795714.title: Therapy

795728.synopsis:
In an elite arts high school for musical prodigies, three young musicians’ lives become intertwined through music, rivalry, and emotion.

Piano prodigy Kang Bi O is consistently ranked first in both academics and performance. Praised as a future star destined for the world’s top competitions, his steady path begins to shake when he encounters an unexpected rival. That rival, Choi Jeong Yo, is a gifted pianist who abandoned his talent after a difficult childhood. His sudden arrival at the school brings him face to face with the musician who once reignited his passion for music, forcing him to confront the gift he had long buried.

Completing the trio is Hong Jae In, a viola major with exceptionally sensitive hearing. Constantly searching for music that truly moves her, she becomes a close friend and devoted supporter of Kang Bi O, whose playing has captivated her since childhood. As intense competition evolves into connection, the three youths collide and grow within the pressure-filled world of music, forming friendships born from rivalry, emotions shaped by ambition, and a powerful harmony created through their shared passion.

(Source: MyDramaList)

796052.synopsis:

Ian meets Alt, a netizen he's drawn to, and discovers he's actually his former senior, Ju Hyeok, who's usually pretty cold to him! Ian feels like he's been tricked, but it turns out Ju Hyeok has a crush on him for a long time...

(Source: kisskh)
798798.title: Connect

798802.synopsis:
An investigative occult romance drama about a hotel heiress who can see ghosts and a passionate prosecutor who team up in a chaotic partnership. The heiress is haunted every night by the restless spirits of people who died unjustly, while the prosecutor works tirelessly to solve unsolved murder cases, taking on society’s hidden evils together.

Cheon Yeo Ri is the heiress of one of Korea’s top conglomerates and the CEO of a luxury hotel. With stunning beauty and undeniable aura of wealth, she seems to have everything, but she hides a fatal secret: she can see ghosts.

Ma Gang Uk is an ace prosecutor with great physique, intelligence, rich emotions, and a just nature who ends up falling in love with a woman who can see ghosts.

(Source: Soompi; edited by MyDramaList)
798802.title: Spooky in Love

798826.synopsis:
A disaster romance centered on Kang U Ju, an air traffic controller who can see his former lover’s emotions through the weather, and An Ha Ni, a pilot cursed with a condition in which her emotional state becomes the weather. The series portrays the turbulent emotions of love, much like the ever-changing and unpredictable weather.

Kang U Ju, an air traffic controller and former flight instructor. Once renowned for his exceptional skills and nicknamed the “Mad Captain,” he gave up flying and settled on Jeju Island, where he now works as an air traffic controller. As the ace of the control tower, he possesses sharp judgment and fluent English skills, but on his days off, his only hobby is watching the clouds. One day, however, his life is upended by the sudden appearance of An Ha Ni.

 An Ha Ni, a pilot whose emotions cause the weather to change. A workaholic who never shies away from difficult assignments in pursuit of a promotion, she is cursed after an unexpected accident leaves her emotions reflected in the weather. As if that were not enough, reuniting with her ex-boyfriend Kang U Ju stirs up the feelings she had long kept buried.

(Source: Soompi)
798826.title: Love Cloud

798848.synopsis:
Tae Rim, determined to leave behind the life of a killer after his final mission, unexpectedly comes face-to-face with Ji Won, his former love. Ji Won, now a top-ranked home-care specialist, senses Tae Rim's trace through a lighter found in a client's home. After a brief misunderstanding, the two reunite with blades drawn between them.

(Source: sipff.kr)
798848.title: A Killer Recipe

(Source: Soompi)
798918.title: The Apartment Job

A casual purchase of a Checkered Shirt through Karrot Market leads to an unexpected connection with a mysterious man, sparking curiosity and unspoken emotions. Jeong U experiences lingering feelings and encounters new possibilities.

798922.title: Checkered Shirt: Uncut Version

798926.synopsis:
A man born incapable of feeling love crosses paths with a woman who no longer believes in it. Kwon Chae U, the brilliant yet psychopathic heir to a powerful conglomerate, has lived his life without understanding human emotion. So I Yeon, a devoted arborist who sees love as nothing more than a beautiful illusion, unexpectedly becomes entangled with him.

As their lives intertwine, the impossible begins to happen: the man who cannot love starts to change, while the woman who has closed her heart is forced to confront feelings she thought she'd left behind. Together, they embark on an unexpected journey to discover whether love can exist even for those who believe it never could.

(Source: MyDramaList)

798926.title: Love Bait

798950.synopsis:
Tells the story of Ha Min Su, one of the few remaining werewolves in the world. Raised under her father’s strict guidance to live a fully socialized human life, Min Su has always suppressed her instincts — until she experiences the one emotion she was never prepared for: an overwhelming, forbidden love. 

Having learned to conceal her true identity, Min Su struggles between keeping her secret and following her heart — especially when she falls for Kwon Hae Jun, an older student who represents everything she desires but can never have. While Kwon Hae Jun is a charismatic and seemingly perfect campus senior on the outside, he hides deep emotional wounds and secrets behind his composed smile. 

Opposite them is Lee Do Ha, also one of the last surviving werewolves on Earth. Isolated by choice, Do Ha unleashes his predatory instincts only when hunting down drug dealers and criminals, living as a lone wolf torn between instinct and morality.

(Source: Global Beauties; Zapzee)
798950.title: She, Wolf

(Source: GagaOOLala)

A novelist yearning for silence and a musician haunted by loneliness clash through the wall that separates them. What begins as a deal to quiet the noise turns into nights of passion, healing, and inspiration—where only each other’s presence can protect them from the darkness.

(Source: TMDb)
800184.title: The Guy Next Door

800234.synopsis:
In 2040, South Korea abolishes the death penalty and enacts a law granting victims’ families the right to punish offenders. Choi Tae Sik, a five-term congressman who had strongly opposed both the abolition and the new law, faces tragedy when his late-born daughter is abducted and murdered. Seventeen-year-old orphan Min U Hyeok is captured as the culprit but receives only a light juvenile sentence.

Persuaded by his wife—out of both repentance and political calculation—Choi adopts Min U Hyeok. Outwardly he plays the role of a father, yet inwardly he harbors an unrelenting desire to kill him. As years pass, hatred and a forced semblance of familial bond intertwine. Then, history repeats itself: Choi Tae Sik’s granddaughter is murdered in the very same way.

(Source: Welcon.kocca.kr/en)
800234.title: Human Is Human

800250.synopsis:
A sports coming-of-age drama depicting the brilliant friendship and growth of a high school pitcher struggling with the yips and a mysterious transfer student who becomes his devoted manager. 

(Source: Welcon.kocca.kr/en)
800250.title: Wind Up

800276.synopsis:
One day, Ha Na wakes up to find herself in the world of a romance novel—as the first fiancée of the male lead. The problem? Her character is a minor one destined to be poisoned at the engagement party of Cheon Nam Ju, heir to the Cheonnam Group. To avoid her tragic fate, Ha Na proposes a contract marriage to Park U Jin, the notorious "tyrant" and acting chairman of the rival Samjeong Group. U Jin accepts the offer, and Ha Na’s destiny begins to veer in an unpredictable direction.

(Source: ReelShort)
800276.title: The Tyrant’s Bride-To-Be

800280.synopsis:
During high school, Choi Jeong Min endured long-term bullying from Ha Ju Hyeon. Her only solace was taking revenge on Ha Ju Hyeon through "lucid dreaming" in a world where no one could interfere. One day, she encountered a mysterious man named Ju Jae Hyeon in her dreams, who offered to help her take revenge on all those who had hurt her. As the plan progressed, a subtle yet dangerous emotion began to grow between them...

(Source: iQIYI SHORT DRAMA YouTube)

A powerful and thrilling romance between a novelist and a fitness trainer.

800296.synopsis:
Yun Yeong Won dislikes his workaholic boss, Kwon Tae In. He is too strict and serious. After working late one night, a computer error appears. Kwon Tae In gets electrocuted, while trying to fix it, and wakes up to find himself experiencing RPG-like game elements around him.

A progression bar appears above Yun Yeong Won's head, tracking his affinity for his boss. If Kwon In can't complete the quests given to him, he will die. Reluctantly, Tae In tries to complete the quests, even when all of them have to do with making Yun Yeong Won fall in love with him. To make matters worse, Yeong Won's ex-boyfriend can't seem to let him go!

(Source: MyDramaList)

When your relationship undergoes changes over time and doubts begin to surface, is it possible to revert to the way it was?

A rookie office worker, Seok Min, who has no time to care for his plants and puts them up for adoption, and Jae Ho, a new tenant experiencing his very first gardening—together they grow a fresh and budding love story.

(Source: strongberry.kr Instagram)

801374.synopsis:
A cheerful and comical legal detective drama about a ragtag law firm led by a former lawyer and current office manager, Kwon Baek, who, in unprecedented ways, turns an unwinnable fight into a win. 

Kwon Baek is a former star lawyer and current office manager at Seungsan Law Firm. After being embroiled in a bribery scandal, Kwon Baek lost his license and then vanished, making a spectacular comeback as the "office manager" of a ragtag law firm he founded with a ragtag crew. Having experienced both ups and downs, Kwon Baek, now more relaxed, sets traps and puts on a show to uncover the truth, creating a stir as an eccentric office manager who is even more capable and entertaining than his days as a lawyer.

Yeo Sim Hui is a rookie lawyer with no money or connections, but a diligent and dedicated team. Yeo Sim Hui accepts Kwon Baek's offer to recruit her, unaware that her one and only role model has fallen from grace due to a bribery scandal, and becomes the head lawyer at Seungsan Law Firm. Disappointed by her role model's deteriorating performance, Yeo Sim Hui is deeply moved by the sight of Kwon Baek, the eccentric office manager she once thought was just idle, foreseeing his next move. Under Kwon Baek's guidance, she grows into a respectable lawyer.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
801374.title: The Long Shot Trial

801396.synopsis:
Twin sisters O Jang Mi and Ma Seo Rin live completely opposite lives. Jang Mi is a warm and honest woman who fights for what’s right, while Seo Rin, a reckless chaebol heiress, is used to getting her way no matter the cost. When fate intertwines their worlds, they find themselves walking paths meant for the other; uncovering painful secrets, unexpected love, and dangerous rivalries that blur the line between justice and desire.

Their fates become further entangled with brothers Kang Baek Ho, a kind-hearted lawyer who believes in doing good, and Kang Jun Ho, a cold, perfectionist chef who hides a fragile heart beneath his stoic exterior. Both brothers are drawn to Jang Mi in different ways, setting off a storm of emotions that none of them can escape.

Meanwhile, Jin Hong Ju, an ambitious Dream Hotel employee consumed by jealousy and obsession, sees Jang Mi as the obstacle standing between her and Baek Ho. And looming above them all is Chae Hwa Yeong, a former top star whose elegance masks a ruthless ambition to seize control of Dream Group. Behind her graceful smile lies a calculating woman who will stop at nothing, even if it means burning everything in her path.

As hidden motives unravel and love turns into a weapon, Jang Mi and Seo Rin must face not only each other but the merciless world ruled by greed, revenge, and ambition.

(Source: MyDramaList)
801396.title: First Man

801426.synopsis:
By the sea, a contract binds two strangers: Han Jae Hun, a cold heir hiding pain, and Kim Hae Jun, a bright art student burdened by life.

What begins as a transaction slowly softens into tenderness. Through hidden loneliness and unspoken care, they grow close—yet the contract keeps their hearts guarded. As tides rise and secrets surface, they must choose: remain bound by rules, or dare to love freely. An autumn, a villa, a story of forced closeness and real feeling, waiting for the tide to tell.

(Source: seekmediagroup YouTube)
801426.title: Tide of Love

801452.synopsis:
Everyone has imagined it at least once. What if you could go back to the past?

Jang Hye Seong, a well-known painter, visits his alma mater, Seongjin High School, to give a special lecture at the request of his friend Tae Jun. During a break, he stops by the art room and discovers his old sketchbook. Inside it, he finds a drawing of his first love, Lee U Jin, half torn.

On impulse, Hye Seong redraws U Jin right there. The moment he finishes the painting and puts the brush down, he is suddenly transported back to 2008, his high school days, where he reunites with U Jin.

Even after returning, Hye Seong doesn’t want to repeat the mistakes he made back then, so he tries to keep his distance from U Jin. But with U Jin boldly and persistently coming closer, Hye Seong is left completely defenseless.

Their eighteen begins again. Can they change their fate and finally reach each other?

(Source: Korean = idol_romance X || Translation = MyDramaList)
801452.title: Always Meet Again

801458.synopsis:
A capable exorcist recognized by the Vatican. He expels demons with a powerful Holy Spirit that requires relics to subdue. Adopted to the United States as a child, he was abandoned again and raised in a church. He came to Korea in search of his biological parents, but was tricked by Mi Ho into coming to Jeju Island, where he stayed by her side and protected her.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
801458.title: Priest Johan

801480.synopsis:
Hallyu star Geon U gradually crumbles under the pressure of endless sasaeng fans and the entertainment industry, and one day he accidentally gets entangled with college student Jae Yeon.

Witnessing her boss’s unusual tastes, the power dynamic flips in an instant! An intense love–hate romance begins between employee Jang Se Yeon and team leader Kang Seung Gi.

801514.title: My Boss, My Rules

801546.synopsis:
Yeo Eui Ju an ordinary high school student who is average in every way and tries to keep a low profile at school. But at night, she secretly becomes a writer, posting daring adults-only BL novels online. Despite her enthusiasm, her work barely gets any views. Though highly observant and empathetic, she has always been hopeless when it comes to real-life romance. However, her life as a writer takes an unexpected turn when four handsome new teachers arrive at her school.

Among them is Ga U Su, a cold and brilliant math prodigy from a family of renowned mathematicians, who gave up studying abroad after a life-changing incident nearly cost him his vision. No Da Ju, a playful and mischievous Japanese teacher born to a wealthy family, is a gifted polyglot fluent in multiple languages and U Su’s longtime friend, despite their constant squabbling. Jung Gi Jeon, a former luge athlete forced to retire due to injury, is now a warm but clumsy sports teacher who is popular among students and sees Eui Ju as his next prodigy, recognizing her exceptional talent in running. Lastly, Yun Dong Ju is a warm-hearted and modest Korean teacher who is respectful and soft-spoken, treats his students with respect, always uses honorifics, and never loses his temper.

As these four charming new teachers arrive at her school, they become her unexpected muses. Their presence turns both her everyday life and her writing upside down.

(Source: Amazon MGM Studios; edited by MyDramaList)
801546.title: Absolute Value of Romance

801740.synopsis:
Hase Taiga who has been working part-time at the small restaurant "Tanomi" for three years, was once a promising young man as the ace of the university's relay team, but his past was ruined by poor performance. Although he doesn't have any particular dreams at the moment, he is beginning to feel a sense of fulfillment in his work, such as being entrusted by the owner with coming up with new menu items. Meanwhile, Park Rin, from South Korea, a graduate student studying animation is busy working on her assignments.

Just when she feels relieved after somehow managing to submit her assignment just before the deadline, she receives a notice to move out of her student dormitory... However, for a foreigner, finding housing in Japan is not an easy task, and she is exhausted both physically and mentally... Then the two have a chance encounter at Tanomi. Rin is moved by the onigiri Taiga serves her, and her hunger and tiredness are gradually satisfied. Taiga is captivated by Rin's smile as she eats them deliciously. And the moment their eyes meet, an irresistible thrill flows between them.

(Source: Japanese = oricon.co.jp || Translation = MyDramaList)

A handsome guy I ran into on the street turned out to be a paper-folding villain. The fresh romance between a man obsessed with paper-folding and a man obsessed with another man.

802086.title: Folding? You!

A man in trouble after his secret is discovered, and a man who enjoys that situation. A thrilling and fresh romance blooming amidst unfamiliar emotions.

Min Ju and Ji O, part-time workers at a BL café. Their own love story begins, not someone else’s fantasy.

Actor Je Ha and his manager Tae Yun have been together since debut. But as Je Ha takes on his first melodrama role, Tae Yun's resolve begins to falter, making it harder to stay by his side.

Seon U, who insists on a relationship that only involves sex, sets three rules, and Ha Jun, who still doesn't want to lose him, accepts a risky proposal.

802096.synopsis:
On his first day at the cram school, Seong Yun trips and spills his candy. The one who helps him pick it up is Hyeon Su, and Seong Yun falls for him at first sight. From that day on, he tries to talk to Hyeon Su by offering him sweets, but Hyeon Su's indifferent reactions only confuse him. Amid conflict, misunderstandings and playful back-and-forth, the two gradually draw closer to each other's true feelings.

(Source: sipff.kr)
802096.title: Something Sweet

802194.synopsis:
Do Yun, an emotionally guarded composer, unexpectedly encounters his toxic ex-boyfriend Ji Heon. Driven by impulse to protect his broken pride, Do Yun lies and says that Ha Jun, a free-spirited freelancer learning guitar from him, is his new lover. To make the ruse convincing, Do Yun proposes a fake relationship contract to Ha Jun. 

However, as Ji Heon keeps intruding and the lines between pretense and intimacy begin to blur through forced closeness, Do Yun and Ha Jun find themselves facing genuine feelings they can no longer deny.

(Source: GagaOOLala)
802194.title: Bound Contract

802278.synopsis:
The story depicts the intense coaching competition within the world of men’s professional baseball.

Hwang Jin Ho is a coach and acting head coach for the Stars. He began playing baseball in the fourth grade and was once selected for the national team, though he never had the chance to wear the national team uniform. He lived a second‑rate life as a player and a one‑and‑a‑half‑rate life as a coach, yet his reputation as a coach now far surpasses anything he achieved during his playing days.

Cho Dong Hui, the Stars’ pitching coach, is universally recognized as the team’s greatest legendary pitcher, having recorded 189 career wins. His impressive career includes two Olympic medals and serving as Korea’s starting pitcher in the WBC game against Japan. However, when he finds himself coaching alongside Hwang Jin Ho—whom he once considered inferior during their playing careers—the two develop a rivalry. Their contrasting baseball philosophies lead to escalating conflict.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
802278.title: Full Count

802302.synopsis:
After a drunken accident, Su Hyeon accidentally kisses someone five years younger and suddenly, that younger guy keeps appearing in his life. Embarrassed and clueless about what to do next, he starts avoiding him, but his friend’s teasing and blunt advice might just force him to face the messy, unexpected feelings that come with a drunken mistake.

(Source: Eva at MyDramaList)
tags: Homosexual Falling For A Straight Person
802302.title: Please, Yes

802304.synopsis:
The continuation of Park Jeong U and Lee Han Gyeol's love story after graduation. At first, Han Gyeol is happy in his relationship. Then, his ex shows up and starts spreading rumours about him. Around the same time, Jeong U suddenly cuts off all contact and vanishes without an explanation. Years later, they reunite at the same company, facing each other for the first time since their breakup.

(Source: blwatcher.com; edited by MyDramaList)
802304.title: Checkered Shirt Season 2

802388.synopsis:
Yun Su, a new resident from Cheonan, moves into a shared house and tries to hide his identity, but his roommate, Ha Jin, catches him out, sparking a delicate emotional battle.

Through punishment dates and casual flirtations, the two move beyond pranks and threats, becoming drawn to each other. However, Ha Jin's sudden departure and public confession spark a conflict, forcing Yun Su to choose between secrecy and honesty.

(Source: Korean = filmmakers.co.kr || Translation = MyDramaList)
802388.title: Share House

802430.synopsis:
Depicts the romance between a man who once was a swimmer but lost his right leg to illness and a woman who finds a new path as a graduate student after an unexpected academic crisis. Set within a university robotics lab, the series follows the bittersweet daily lives and healing connections of postgraduate students.

Park Min Jae, a man who lost his promising swimming career and his right leg to osteosarcoma. After hitting rock bottom, he discovers a new purpose in robotics. Years of dedication pay off when he enters the PhD program in the Department of Mechanical Engineering at Seoul National University. While he hides a deeply sensitive nature behind a nonchalant facade, he is secretly just a simple guy who has dating at the top of his bucket list.

Im Yu Jin, a straightforward and headstrong student who is on the verge of graduating from the Department of Clothing and Textiles. When a sudden incident upends her original academic goals and ruins her plans for graduate school, she crosses paths with Min Jae. Fascinated by his research, she pivots completely and enrolls in a master’s program in mechanical engineering, fearlessly pursuing both a new dream and her growing feelings.

(Source: Soompi; edited by ElfinieKarl at MyDramaList)
802430.title: Between Steps

80247.synopsis:
An omnibus web series about four individuals filled with regret who are able to order delivery from a mysterious new restaurant called "Your Most Beautiful Days." The order allows them to relive their past or see their future.

(Source: MyDramaList)
80247.title: Can You Deliver Time?

802480.synopsis:
A fantastic duo of a political master and a complete novice!

I’m Koo Yeong Jin, a six-term congressman — the pinnacle of South Korea’s political world, the nation’s hope! One fateful day in 2008, betrayed by my closest aides, I faced a special investigation and chose to end my own life. When I opened my eyes… it was Seoul, 10 years in the past?!

Now a ghost, no one can see me or hear my voice. No one... except one person, Cha Jae Rim, a 25-year-old Level 9 civil servant.

No connections, no money, stuck in miserable circumstances... But look at that ambition, that fire in his eyes... I like it! Fine. I’ll make him my partner.

“You need to go into politics.”

And I’ll get my revenge.

A political genius ghost, Koo Yeong Jin, teams up with a clueless rookie, Cha Jae Rim, for the ultimate combo in.

(Source: MangaUpdates)

~~ Adapted from the web novel “The Congressman Sends My Condolences" (의원님이 보우하사) by Kim Hyeon Bin (김현빈).

802482.synopsis:
An office romantic comedy that follows the story of a conglomerate heir and his new secretary, a former special forces officer now working undercover.

Yun I Jun is a quirky third-generation chaebol raised in a sheltered environment who becomes a prime suspect in the mysterious murder of his previous secretary. When a new “male” secretary arrives to take the position, he has no idea that she’s hiding a major secret.

To uncover the truth, Kang Jae Hui, a former special forces officer turned police officer renowned as a “human weapon” for her exceptional strength and combat skills, disguises herself as a man and goes undercover as Yun I Jun’s personal secretary and bodyguard.

While protecting him, she secretly investigates him, setting the stage for unexpected chemistry, hidden identities, and plenty of comedic tension.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Why You Don't Know It's a Girl?" (여자인 걸 왜 모르지?) by Lee A Yeon (이아연) and Ryu Do Ha (류도하).

802546.synopsis:
A woman in her 70s, wielding a gun of vengeance for her grandson, and the man who awakened her hunting instincts wage a desperate revenge against the criminal organization Chunghwa Group.

(Source: Korean = Namu.Wiki || Translation = cora at MyDramaList)

802604.synopsis:
A hanok that was remodeled from an old house. Paradoxically, this place is named Modern Share House. People who have no special purpose but come here for their own reasons. Strangers with different backgrounds and values gather under one roof, sometimes conflicted, sometimes comforting, and finding the true meaning of 'togetherness.

O Dan Ha is a star of Yeonwol-dong, he is kind to everyone and always steps up to handle difficult tasks. However, he is trapped in a fate he cannot tell anyone about, and it torments him. The deeper his feelings grow for Kang Ha Ru, the more confused he becomes.

Kang Ha Ru has devoted her entire life to her family. When her mother suddenly orders her to take charge of the share house, the resentment she has suppressed for years finally erupts. But as she lives with O Dan Ha and the other share-house residents, she slowly begins to realize her own true worth.

(Source: youngcontents.com)
802604.title: Modern Sharehouse

802646.synopsis:
Two men are held captive naked, forced to engage in physical intimacy, and filmed by a male kidnapper.

(Source: MyDramaList)
802646.title: Secret

802692.synopsis:
A contract killer, Seo I Do, arrives at a secluded house to take out his target, Heo Dong Hwa. Before he can finish the job, his boss unexpectedly orders him to stay put and to keep Dong Hwa captive instead. Things get messy fast when a cheerful stranger, Chu Tae Jeong, suddenly shows up. He’s an old friend of Dong Hwa and was already promised a week-long stay.

Their first meeting crackles with tension, and in the chaos, Tae Jeong mistakes I Do for Dong Hwa’s older brother, who supposedly left for the US years ago. I Do rides that misunderstanding, acting like the brother while quietly plotting to get Tae Jeong out of the way. His plan takes a sharp turn when he discovers Tae Jeong is actually a detective.

Forced into an uneasy, secret-laden cohabitation, I Do tries to keep his identity hidden while Tae Jeong keeps getting closer; both to the truth and to him. What starts as a dangerous game soon turns into an attraction neither of them can shake. Caught between his life as an assassin and a growing pull toward Tae Jeong, I Do’s world starts to crack. And when buried secrets finally surface, he’s left with one brutal choice: finish the mission or risk everything for the man hunting the truth.

(Source: MyDramaList)
802692.title: The Lie We Lived In

802838.synopsis:
Set in a world where AI has infiltrated human dreams, creating a system that punishes criminals by trapping them in inescapable nightmares. When offenders evade the law, they are instead subjected to this technology, which manipulates the subconscious and turns fear into a tool of justice.

Detective Kim Tae I of the Violent Crimes Unit at Nambu Police Station, known for his sharp instincts and relentless pursuit of the truth, becomes entangled in a series of cases linked to this dream-based punishment system. As he investigates, he uncovers a larger conspiracy behind the AI technology, confronting a reality where human fear and desire are weaponized.

Working alongside him is Detective Jang Gyu Eun, a shy and introverted victim specialist haunted by the trauma of a tragic childhood accident. Driven by a need for vengeance, she hides a dark role within the system—transforming in the dream world into a ruthless “nightmare architect” who torments criminals who have escaped justice.

As the two navigate cases that blur the line between law and retribution, they are drawn deeper into a dangerous world where justice is no longer decided in court, but within the human mind.

(Source: MyDramaList)
802838.title: Akmong

803222.synopsis:
A meticulous and intense revenge chronicle in which two women who return under false identities uncover the truth and sins hidden in the Adel family. 

Kim Myeong Hui, the older sister of her twin Kim Dan Hui, is a kind-hearted nurse who dreams of a normal family life, but encounters an unexpected truth and meets a tragic fate. Kim Dan Hui, the younger sister, learns the truth behind her sister's death and decides to abandon her own life and live under her sister's name. She embarks on a meticulous quest for revenge to take over the Adel Group. 

Chloe Lee, who, after losing her family in an unexpected accident, abandons both her name and identity to pursue revenge and takes on the role of a world-renowned brand consultant. Her ordinary life is shattered in an instant, and she enters the Adel Group under a new identity, meticulously plotting revenge. However, her plans begin to falter when she encounters an unexpected ambush. 

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
803222.title: Pearl in Red

803262.synopsis:
Depicts the story of a man who comes back from the dead nine times to save a woman. A woman once again falling in love with him after reuniting with him for the tenth time. Nam Ji O, a high school senior preparing for the national Taekwondo team trials, and Cha Gyeol, a boy with a mysterious charm.

A tear-jerking melodrama about a stormy romance, 100 years in the making. Their reason to die.

(Source: Media Group Take2, Naver; edited by MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "My Reason to Die" (내가 죽기로 결심한 것은) by YUJU (유주).
803262.title: Naega Jukgilo Gyeolsimhan Geoteun

803410.synopsis:
A story about a family that sometimes makes you wish it wasn't your own, that you could just throw it all away. Yet, despite that, it's family. Even if you fight every morning before leaving, you face each other that evening as if nothing happened. If someone doesn't come home, you worry, but outwardly, you yell, ‘Why are you crawling back in?’ You can torment them, but if they come home crying from being tormented elsewhere, that day becomes war. It's the story of a family shattered into pieces.

Han Gyu Rim is the owner of a market side dish shop. Her nickname since childhood was "Leader Han." A movie with the long title "Leader Han, Who Always Appears When Something Happens to Someone, Somewhere," was released, and that's exactly her story. If something is bad or sad, she puts aside all else and rushes to help, making it a little less bad or sad. If it was good, she'd celebrate it like it was her own. She's a nosy busybody, a fluttery-eared, emotional litmus test who can't hide her feelings.

Kim Mu Jin is the owner and chef of an Italian restaurant. Born with a diamond spoon in his mouth, he deliberately wears market clothes to avoid being discovered as the owner's son, taking the bus and subway to work part-time at the restaurant. He develops a strange bond with Han Gyu Rim, the owner of a market side dish shop.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
803410.title: Love on the Menu

803490.synopsis:
A bromance drama between a Generation X retired agent and a Generation Z super ace, pursuing an insider who has been behind a criminal organization for over 25 years. The story of two men who work together as one finds a chance to be reborn as a hero, and the other a chance to fulfill his dream of becoming a field agent.

Kim Cheol Su, a retired black agent and car wash owner. While he may appear to be an ordinary man, hiding his lion's claws and living like a sheep, he is actually a legendary black agent of the National Intelligence Service, codenamed "Phoenix."

Ko Yo Han, a member of the National Intelligence Service's retired agent management team. While possessing exceptional abilities, his excessive self-confidence and autocratic behavior often lead to labeling him a "snobbery" and "servility." He's an anxious perfectionist consumed by a need for self-promotion and recognition.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
803490.title: Euntoeyowon Gwanritim

803492.synopsis:
Na Jeong Seok is a flawless CEO of a camping company, whose life is turned upside down when his former intimidating military superior, Woo A Mi—nicknamed “Viper”—joins his company as a rookie employee.

In the past, Jeong Seok was timid and struggled to adapt to military life. Now, he has transformed into a capable CEO who built his business from the ground up. A Mi, once a fearless special forces ace known for her fierce personality, is now trying to build a new career in civilian life after her discharge.

The two, who once shared a strict senior-junior relationship in the military, reunite as company CEO and new hire, leading to unexpected situations.

(Source: MyDramaList)
803492.title: Fall In! Love

aka: The Seventeenth Day of the Rising Moon
803560.synopsis:
Tells the story of Heo Seol Hui, a woman from the Joseon era who loses everything after her family is destroyed. She then returns to her 20-year-old past and struggles fiercely as she sharpens her blade of revenge.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
803560.title: The First Seventeenth

803562.synopsis:
After a devastating failure as a spatial designer in South Korea, Lee Yu Bin retreats to a remote Japanese island to start over. There, he meets Shirahama Karin, a strawberry farmer living with a mysterious illness. Though they come from different countries and lead completely opposite lives, their chance encounter blossoms into a heartfelt cross-border love story that changes them both.

(Source: MyDramaList)
803562.title: Merry Berry Love

803774.synopsis:
Yeong Su’s family arrive in a new city while hiding their past. As they face an even greater evil force, they carry out a hellish revenge to protect one another.

803774.title: Family Matters Season 2

803836.synopsis:
Japanese high schooler Hirose Hana dreams of becoming a manager for top pop groups. She transfers to Segi Art High School, a South Korean school that has produced some of the Korean entertainment industry’s brightest stars.

Her first few days are a success, and she soon strikes up a friendship with the handsome and popular aspiring singer Koo Eun Ho. But she soon discovers that egos at the school are fragile, and that her own success may be stoking resentment in others. Worse still, someone at the school has learned that she is harboring a secret – and threatens to make it public. Is disaster in the cards for her, or will her new friends help her fulfill her dreams at this highly competitive school?

(Source: Viki)
803836.title: Will You Be My Manager?

803838.synopsis:
A romance anthology containing 10 different love stories. It explores romance, breakups, unrequited love, familial love, and even the love of older adults, singles, and minorities, all in a flexible format unique to short films, broadening the emotional spectrum of love.

There, he meets his new roommate, the personal trainer Tae Hyeon, creating a new physical tension. What will Yun Su do?

(Source: MyDramaList)

803854.synopsis:
A quiet, steadfast stuntman, Jae Yeon, strictly follows his principles. He’s assigned to train Do Ha, an idol cast in an action movie. But Do Ha is unruly, proud, and refuses to listen. Still, Jae Yeon is just as stubborn. He puts a stop to Do Ha’s tricks and shortcuts without mercy, and the two inevitably become bitter rivals.

Then one day, their usual bickering is captured in an idol behind-the-scenes video, and Jae Yeon suddenly gains unexpected popularity… marking the beginning of a situation neither of them saw coming.

(Source: Heavenly)

The story of a couple about to divorce, who agreed to live together only until the down payment due to apartment subscription conditions. They then prepare for separation for a month before moving in.

803892.title: Love Track: Love's Grace Period
