803896.synopsis:
Ha Yeong, shaped by a life of constant moving, keeps people at a distance until she unexpectedly opens her heart to Hui Won. When they attend the same school, the two create an Eternal List, a promise of things to do together as adults. After Hui Won breaks that promise, Ha Yeong's time comes to a halt, and she retreats to a cafe attic, cut off from the world. One day, Do Un appears holding the long-lost list, and with his arrival, Ha Yeong's frozen time begins to move again. Can a promise from the past lead them back to the present?

(Source: Kocowa)
803896.title: Forever Young

803920.synopsis:
South Korea's national drama "Reply 1988," which sparked a phenomenon with its warm, cross-generational storytelling, celebrates its 10th anniversary this year. To mark the occasion, the cast of "Reply 1988" embarks on a two-day trip together. With the same family-like chemistry they've kept for a decade, their lively, nostalgia-filled getaway is already drawing excitement from fans who treasured the original "Reply 1988" era.

(Source: CJ ENM)
803920.title: Reply 1988: 10th Anniversary

804086.synopsis:
Depicts the events that unfold as the Hwanggung Market, a marketplace for buying and selling goods, takes root in the only remaining apartment complex after a devastating earthquake.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)
804086.title: Concrete Market

804094.synopsis:
On the night of a blue moon lunar eclipse that happens once in ten years, the portal between the vampire world, where drinking human blood is forbidden, and the human world opens. Lucifer, a vampire prince who desperately craves human blood, descends into the human world. Min U, a university student in his early twenties, moves to the city from the countryside. He works tirelessly, day and night, to save up for tuition while also studying hard.

However, Min U contracts a rare disease that puts his life at risk whenever he bleeds. One day, Min U becomes a victim of a hit-and-run accident, bleeding and finding himself in a life-threatening situation. Lucifer, drawn by the scent of blood, attacks Min U. However, something strange happens: Lucifer collapses, and Min U miraculously survives, unharmed.

(Source: Korean = plfil.com || Translation = MyDramaList)
804094.title: Sweet Blood

804100.synopsis:
A campus romance that begins when one man steps in to perform a kiss scene on behalf of another — a thrilling misunderstanding and fluttering emotions ignite between them, leading to an explosion of crossed feelings.

(Source: Shortime App)
804100.title: Just Once!

804102.synopsis:
The story depicts the journey of discovering the meaning of life lost in nature and living alongside forgotten neighbors.

Here are two individuals who are unable to move forward due to their past and fear of the future. Deok Hyeon, and An Na, a job seeker paralyzed by anxiety, become Haenyo (female divers) in order to flow, plunging into the sea with nothing but their bodies. The cost is steep, yet they experience things they couldn't feel in the stagnant world they came from. Deok Hyeon sees the sea as a refuge, while An Na sees it as an escape. Despite their different backgrounds, they find solace diving into the ocean.

(Source: Welcon.kocca.kr/en)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Azure Spring" (아주르 스프링) by Jang Deok Hyeon (장덕현).
804102.title: Azure Spring

804104.synopsis:
Jae Yeong and Su Hyeon had feelings for each other, but their timing never worked out, and they drifted apart without becoming a couple. A year later, they reunite by chance at a drinking gathering. Despite the awkwardness, they bicker like they used to, creating a strangely charged atmosphere. What exactly happened between them a year ago?

(Source: GagaOOLala)
804104.title: Almost Lover

804182.synopsis:
Kim Ji Hun and Kong Hu Gyeong, two strangers in a foreign country, meet by chance and spend an unforgettable, dreamlike day and night together. Though they know their connection should end once they return to Korea, they are unable to resist the growing attraction between them.

Back home, what was meant to be a fleeting encounter lingers, and their reunion sets off a turbulent course that begins to crack the stability of their lives. Ji Hun, a man with a stable career and a happy marriage, finds his world starting to unravel, while his wife, Lee Seon Hui, is confronted with shocking truths about their relationship.

At the same time, Seon Hui’s younger brother, Dae Hui, becomes entangled in an unexpected relationship with Hu Gyeong. As the consequences of that single encounter spread, the lives of Ji Hun, Hu Gyeong, Seon Hui, and Dae Hui are gradually shaken and upended.

(Source: MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Love Affair" (러브 어페어) by Lee Yu Jin (이유진).
804182.title: The Facade of Love

804228.synopsis: ~~ Adapted from the novel series "Again My Life" (어게인 마이 라이프) by Lee Hae Nal (이해날).
804228.title: Again My Life Season 2

804316.synopsis:
Namgung Ho is a cheerful assistant manager at Hunmin Confectionery who hides a difficult past. Through it all, his girlfriend of 10 years, Lee Mi Do, a once-promising film director whose career has hit rock bottom, has always been his anchor.

Now, after a decade together, their relationship is built on loyalty and trust, but the passion has faded. They are left questioning whether to break up or take the next step and get married.

(Source: MyDramaList)
804316.title: A Love Other than Yours

804376.synopsis:
Nine years after a certain past incident, Koo Seung Hyeok and Kwon I Hyeon reunite by chance at Nexus, a nightclub tied to an underground crime syndicate. Seung Hyeok now holds power as the club’s manager, while I Hyeon survives as expendable labor. Their reunion is anything but neutral. I Hyeon keeps his distance, but Seung Hyeok confronts him with open hostility, dredging up unresolved resentment that costs I Hyeon his job and reopens wounds neither of them truly healed.

When I Hyeon’s estranged father is diagnosed with cancer, desperation pulls him back into Seung Hyeok’s orbit. Instead of demanding repayment, Seung Hyeok offers a deal that binds them through work and debt. Forced into close proximity, contempt slowly blurs with fixation, and emotions Seung Hyeok calls hatred begin to feel dangerously unstable.

A gay man shaped by rejection and survival, and a violently homophobic man trapped in denial, they are pushed to confront the past they tried to erase. As tensions rise and truths resurface, they must decide whether to keep hurting each other or face a future neither of them ever planned to share.

(Source: MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Winter Season" (동절기) by Iromil (이로밀).
804376.title: Wintertime

804498.synopsis:
An unexpected incident strikes just as Alt and Ian are dreaming of a happy first anniversary. 

(Source: @truefilm2025 X)
804498.title: Cross Link

804508.synopsis:
Handsome college student Ho Won is attracted to Min U, who seems out of place at a gay bar he frequents.
After hearing that no one has been able to seduce him, Ho Won approaches him. However, Min U seems blunt and old-fashioned. Ho Won develops a crush on him.

(Source: Korean = filmmakers.co.kr || Translation = MyDramaList)
804508.title: Opposites Attract

804632.synopsis:
Jeong Yeon joins the research lab of Yu Geon, his former private tutor, as an intern. However, Yu Geon’s attitude upon their reunion is cold.

An experiment that studies emotions, and two people facing each other once again. Subtle waves begin to ripple between Jeong Yeon and Yu Geon.

(Source: GND STUDIO YouTube)
804632.title: Love in Protocol

804662.synopsis:
Yun Jae accidentally enters Do Hyeon’s apartment while drunk, and their first meeting begins with an unexpected kiss. Afterward, they keep running into each other in the same apartment complex and gradually grow closer. Yun Jae finds himself drawn to Do Hyeon, while Do Hyeon, quiet and reserved, also begins to develop feelings for him.

(Source: QueerDeep YouTube)
804662.title: Between Doors

804782.synopsis:
'Goodness was a virtue, and taboo was beautiful.' Between virtue and taboo, the most beautiful rift.

(Source: CITYBOY_LOG X)
804782.title: Saint Laurence Academy

804868.synopsis:
Jung Ba Reum’s planner might be full, but one thing she desperately needs in her diary is a date. When she is lured into joining a programming club by her friend’s hot coworker, it looks like there might be hope for her. But will her inexperience lead to her downfall? And why does she keep running into his bad-tempered friend instead?

(Source: MangaUpdates)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon "Romance 101" (바른연애 길잡이) by Nam Su (남수).
804868.title: Bareunyeonae Giljabi

804990.synopsis:
Life, like clothes, sometimes gets wrinkled and shriveled.

Jae Min, a 30-year-old job seeker who lives with anxiety that clings to him like grime, and Ji Seok, a 34-year-old voluntary unemployed person who threw away his well-ironed shirt and chose to stop.
A healing romance between two men that blends in with the noise of the washing machines running late at night at a coin laundromat.

(Source: Korean = filmmakers.co.kr || Translation = MyDramaList)
804990.title: Laundry Romance

804992.synopsis:
As Hae Jun and Jae Hun prepare to celebrate their first Christmas and New Year together, Jae Hun takes Hae Jun to another secret villa of his. 

What was meant to be a sweet memory soon turns tense with the return of their close friend, Kang Su Hyeok. Under the guise of a “best friend,” he methodically uncovers Jae Hun’s hidden past, turning long-buried secrets into sharp weapons, and seeks to leave the mark of a “third party” in their relationship—everything seemingly part of a cruel, twisted game. Amid the waves stirred by Su Hyeok, can their love survive the test and grow even stronger?

(Source: GagaOOLala)
804992.title: Tide of Love Season 2

804994.synopsis:
Ji Hun and Do Jin have been in a happy relationship for five years, that is, until Do Jin unexpectedly demanded a break-up with no explanation. 

Fast forward one year, and Ji Hun has finally decided to try to move on. However, no matter what, he couldn't form a strong connection with anyone. Finally, his attention gets caught on someone on a dating app, but he never would have expected the stranger to turn out to be his past long-term relationship. 

Will they be able to pretend to be strangers? Will their relationship work again?

(Source: MyDramaList)
804994.title: Long-Term Relationship

aka: Four Ways to Find a Wife
805022.synopsis:
It started with a chance encounter in a secluded garden. You know, your typical boy-meets-girl romance. So then, why does he keep chasing her down and asking to see her photos? And hold up—he’s advertising for a wife?! Jeong Won just wants to survive her college years, but this business executive isn’t making it easy! She doesn’t have time for distractions between taking care of her siblings, working part-time, and studying for classes. But there’s another thing bothering her...who is the mysterious person leaving her notes?

(Source: MangaUpdates)

805110.synopsis:
Imaizumi Rintaro, once a detective at the Kuramaebashi Police Station, is suddenly transferred to Public Relations Section 2. He originally joined the Metropolitan Police Department with the goal of becoming a First Investigative Division detective. Believing that the next transfer would finally place him in his dream post—the elite, highly respected First Division—he is stunned to receive an unexpected assignment to the PR division instead.

To make matters worse, Imaizumi has harbored a strong dislike for reporters ever since a traumatic case in his past. For him, being sent to a division that works closely with the press is completely beyond imagination…

(Source: japan-programcatalog.com/en)
805110.title: Tokyo MPD PR Unit 2

805266.synopsis:
Set in the Joseon era, a time when women were oppressed. The story follows a woman, Seo Hong, who defies her fate and embraces her desires, and a man, Seo Jae Ha, who loves her but must accept his own fate and conceal his desires.

Seo Jae Ha, the son of a butcher who grew up in a happy family, but whose life is shattered after his father’s death. He later takes on a new identity as the son of Seo Dong Won, the richest man in Hanyang. He develops complex feelings toward Seo Hong, whom he comes to know as his “sister.”

Seo Hong is the only daughter of Hanyang's wealthiest family. Defying the restrictions placed on women in the Joseon era, she paves her own way. Seo Hong is a determined and shrewd character who, through her intelligence and initiative, builds a successful trading business.

(Source: Korean = Naver || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the webtoon “Night's Fragrance" (밤의 향) by Bori (보리).
805266.title: Bamui Hyang

805276.synopsis:
> Story 1: A Ghost’s First Love (귀신의 첫사랑)
As Jeong A begins experiencing strange physical symptoms, a shaman tells her that she is being haunted by a ghost who died without fulfilling her love. That very night, a female ghost appears before her.

> Story 2: Look at Me (시선고정)
Gyu Ho is a shut-in nerd whose world always feels blurry. Then Min Seung, an optician who changes both his eyesight and his daily life with one pair of glasses, shows up. Gyu Ho’s eyes slowly stop wandering and start focusing on one person.

> Story 3: A Killer Recipe: The Red  (죽이는맛: 더레드)
Tae Rim is lost in deep sorrow after losing his mentor, who was like family to him. Then, he stumbles upon a restaurant by chance and meets Chef Ji Won. Ji Won's thoughtful and warm consideration begins to melt Tae Rim's frozen heart.

> Story 4: President's Secret Mark  (학생회장과 키스마크)
Twenty-year-old freshman Han Ji Hu meets Jung Do Hyeok, the seemingly perfect student council president, at the university's student council welcoming party. That night, while trying to put a band-aid on Do Hyeok's hand cut by a broken glass, Ji Hu faces the precarious cracks in the 'perfect president' everyone idealized and the real scars he had been suppressing...

> Story 5: Rec Off, Kiss On (렉오프 키스온)
Tae Hyeong, a PD at an adults-only audio platform, secretly harbors a crush on voice actor Ji Hun, violating company rules. However, Ji Hun becomes disillusioned after witnessing Tae Hyeong treat him like a mere “product”, leading to a misunderstanding between the two.

> Story 6: Under the Skin (언더 더 스킨)
Internet streamer Jin Sol is surprised to learn that her long-time supporter, “Bella”, is a woman. From their first meeting, however, she feels an unusual chemistry between them. Over the course of one night, the two open up to each other and build an intimate, special bond.

> Story 7: Wanna Meet? (만나볼래요?)
Seok Min and Jae Ho become connected through their shared love of plants. When Seok Min gets busy and starts neglecting him, Jae Ho feels hurt and decides to team up with his friend Do Jin to make him jealous on purpose, hoping to find out what Seok Min really feels.

> Story 8: Home Sweet Homo (홈스윗호모)
Office worker Sang Su is about to move out, while Sung Su, a job seeker, moves into his old place. In the middle of bug disasters, an ex barging in, and late-night ghost rumors, they slowly become a comfortable, home-like presence for each other.

> Story 9: Sweet Misunderstanding (달콤한 오해)
Gi Hyeon and Sun Hu go on a graduation trip. Ki Hyeon plans to spend a quiet, intimate time alone with Sun Hu, but Do Hyeong, the oblivious son of the pension owner, unexpectedly intrudes. Do Hyeong’s attentive care toward Sun Hu and Sun Hu’s seemingly affectionate response fuel Gi Hyeon’s growing jealousy.
